Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: ...Sure, hop on in, there should be enough space for all of you.

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Narration
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: I was a bit sceptical, as it looked like a preety small vehicle from the outside. But as we entered, it was revealed to be much more spacious on the inside that it was on the outside

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Narration
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: Our group of 13 all fit inside perfectly fine as the back seat doors closed and the car began to drive off.

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Male Driver
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: So, there are 13 of you, and a trip between sectors is 20 Div per person...

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Kyla
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: Don't worry about the pricing. Havenus will ensure that you are paid handsomely for your services...

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Female Photographer
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: Wait, you guy's are with Havenus?

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Narration
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: The girl spoke up in an excited high pitched voice in response to what Kyla had said

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Male Driver
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: Calm down Emil. You'll weird out our customers.

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Female Photographer
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: Sorry, I'm just really excited about meating someone from Havenus. So what the goal of you Branch?

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Kyla
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: Well, that would be the finding and destroying of the Spectral Cores that have begun appearing around the crater.

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Female Photographer
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: Woah, that's so cool...

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Male Driver
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: At least introduce yourself first, they don't even know who you are

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Emilia
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: My mistake. My name is Emilia, and his is Joel.

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Joel
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: I said introduce yourself, not me!

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Emilia
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: Woops, my mistake.

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Narration
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: In proper courtesy, me and the rest of the Elite also introduce ourselves to the duo as we drive between hills of orange grass

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Macduff
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: Now that we've introduced ourselves, I have a question. What made you approach the gates of Macbeth Castle. did you also want to try and kill the tyrant

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Emilia
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: No actually. My goal is to take photographs of all the wonders of the crater and bring it back to N Sector. I came here for a picture of the castle...

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Joel
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: And she's paid me to drive her all around the crater to get these pictures, so that's why we were there

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Kyla
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: Interesting. Could I have a look at the pictures you've already collected

Enter W Sector.speaker: Joel

Enter W Sector.dialogue: We all get back into the car as we travel into a tunnel visible from the gate's entrance

Enter W Sector.dialogue: I'd say I know quite alot of stuff about this crater myself.

Enter W Sector.speaker: Jasmine
Enter W Sector.dialogue: Well, I don't know alot, but, if you know anything about the Sector's, I'd find it quite helpful

Enter W Sector.dialogue: Joel looked back at me with a shocked expression before turning back to continue driving

Enter W Sector.speaker: Joel
Enter W Sector.dialogue: How did you even get in here if you don't know even the basics like the point of each of the Sectors

Enter W Sector.dialogue: I... don't know actually. I really just woke up randomly in a place called S Sector and was then picked up by Havenus

Enter W Sector.dialogue: ...Jasmine, was it?

Enter W Sector.dialogue: Emilia turned to talk to me.

Enter W Sector.dialogue: Could I see the world key?

Enter W Sector.dialogue: I actually haven't really tried visualising how it feels to raise one of the elite from the death... Sometimes I feel immense sorrow, sometimes I feel a strong sense of relief, yet, sometimes I feel a strong indifference

Enter W Sector.dialogue: The sea... just as I remember it...

Enter W Sector.dialogue: Welcome to W Sector, the land of merchandice

Clouded Lady.dialogue: It's fine. Who have you seen survive a car...

The Memoria 1.dialogue: Might I ask... what then caused him to desert and betray the king?

The Memoria 1.dialogue: That is something I do not know

The Memoria 1.dialogue: guys. What ever that... thing is, it's awake now...

The Memoria 2.dialogue: What possesses you to speak such words, demon?

The Memoria 2.dialogue: ...Who knows, really...

The Memoria 2.dialogue: The image of Macduff then dissipated before our eyes after Macduff had finished talking to them, and Macduff got up as the room shifted before our eyes again.

The Memoria 2.dialogue: Do you think this could be showing us visions of Macduff's pasts.

The Memoria 2.dialogue: I believe so, miss Jasmine...

The Memoria 2.dialogue: Is he with you or not?

The Memoria 2.dialogue: Ahh. Don't mind my suspicion. I must ensure I am ready to fight incase Macbeth attempts to kill me off

The Memoria 2.speaker: Macduff?
The Memoria 2.dialogue: How are my wife and children, Ross

The Memoria 2.dialogue: ...They... have all ben killed. Put down by assassins of Macbeth

The Memoria 2.speaker: Macduff?
The Memoria 2.dialogue: ...all of them...

The Memoria 2.dialogue: The image of Macduff before us stood shocked for a decent amount of time, before walking away.

The Memoria 2.speaker: Malcolm
The Memoria 2.dialogue: Where are you going, Macduff.

The Memoria 2.speaker: Macduff?
The Memoria 2.dialogue: I... need sometime to think

The Memoria 2.dialogue: The scene then shifts around us once again, this being presumably the final door as the four of us find ourselves in the alleyways of N Sector, or at least that was what I thought they were called after Antonia blurted it out

The Memoria 2.dialogue: If you have come to torment me, it will not work. I have lost to much to care about your worthless proding and poking

The Memoria 2.dialogue: That is not what we're here for. Even if you have lost what you care for, you can still put your skills to use to help people

The Memoria 2.dialogue: Havenus has promised those who have accepted the ability to bring back anyone from the dead on successful completion of this goal...

The Memoria 2.dialogue: The deal looks a lot more acceptable now, doesn't it? So. What do you say solider

The Memoria 2.dialogue: The clouds then suddenly dissipated as we awaken to see The Monster Punching the fan wielding figure in the gut and then kicking them away.

The Memoria 2.speaker: Jasmine
The Memoria 2.dialogue: Ughh, my head.

The Memoria 2.speaker: Joel
The Memoria 2.dialogue: What the hell just happened. I was in some sort of blank space, and...

The Memoria 2.speaker: Emilia
The Memoria 2.dialogue: Ohh, your okay Joel. WHat did you guys do to stop whatever that was.

The Memoria 2.dialogue: I beat them up real well.

The Memoria 2.dialogue: I'm actually really pissed off that worked, honestly...

The Memoria 2.dialogue: Speaking of beating someone up.

The Memoria 2.dialogue: The figure swiftly got up and attempted to set us all the sleep. However, faster than any of us, Romeo had forced her into guarding with a Fleche

The Memoria 2.dialogue: Oh no you don't. Everyone, before they can do anything

FINE. Since you two wish to be stubborn.

The Memoria 2.dialogue: Suddenly, groups upon groups of thugs funneled out of the alleyway the gate blocked.

The Memoria 2.dialogue: Shit, we gotta deal with these guys now. everyone. get ready

Lila of the Fans.dialogue: She's approaching from behind Joel

Lila of the Fans.dialogue: And who are you to decide that.

Lila of the Fans.dialogue: However, she recovered quickly and blocked both their attacks with her fans and knocked them away.
You must be faster than that to hit me, fooli...

Lila of the Fans.dialogue: The figure is just barely able to escape the Monster's grasp as the bullets fly, hitting the monster instead

Lila of the Fans.speaker: Sherlock
Lila of the Fans.dialogue: ...Shit...

Lila of the Fans.speaker: Lila
Lila of the Fans.dialogue: Now that that's dealt with. I, Lila of the fans, shall...

Lila of the Fans.dialogue: The Monster kicks the figure, who we now know is named Lila, away, clearly not being stopped by the bullets that hit him head on

Lila of the Fans.speaker: Lila
Lila of the Fans.dialogue: What the hell are you made of... whatever, you are what I'm here for anyways. All I want is those tw...

Onward1.2.dialogue: Hey, miss Kyla.

Onward1.2.dialogue: Yeah...

Onward1.2.speaker: Emilia
Onward1.2.dialogue: About the spectral cores you were talking about before, where exactly do you need to go to find them

Onward1.2.dialogue: Well, actually, from the data given to us, there is a spectral core in every sector...

Onward1.2.speaker: Emilia

Onward1.2.dialogue: EMILIA!!!

Onward1.2.dialogue: Joel thought for a bit, before responding

Onward1.2.speaker: Joel

Onward1.2.dialogue: That's great, actually, we could use someone of your skill and prowess in our job. Welcome you two.

Onward1.2.speaker: Emilia

Onward1.2.dialogue: Hey! Gabriel!

Onward1.2.dialogue: Is there a reason you picked ME up and brought me HERE of all places. You know I don't do well with water like... at all, right?

Onward1.2.speaker: Gabriel
Onward1.2.dialogue: Ohh, quit the fuss, child. We won't be here for long. We're here because we're looking for someone. Specifically, a Aqua, and one willing to join us

Onward1.2.dialogue: I know that... it's just, a bit of fear. You know, when your surrounded by water and your completely made of fire.
Tell me about it

Onward1.2.speaker: Afine
Onward1.2.dialogue: Tybalt said that the locals told him that they haven't seen any Aquas in ages. They said that they'd look dor them if Divinus is the one asking

Onward1.2.dialogue: And about the spectral core? The one that Havenus is currently after, that is.

Onward1.2.speaker: Afine

Onward1.2.speaker: Gabriel
Onward1.2.dialogue: So were is it then. It has to be somewhere here.

Onward1.2.dialogue: Gabriel said, wrapping a bandage around one of the wounds on his arm that had started bleeding again

Onward1.2.speaker: Afine
Onward1.2.dialogue: Well, we have got a faint reading of life from a small island. People are speculating that that's were the Aquas are, but some people would beg to differ

Onward1.2.speaker: Tybalt
Onward1.2.dialogue: Well, thanks for telling him everything I was meant to say to him, Afine

Onward1.2.speaker: Afine
Onward1.2.dialogue: Well, you snooze, you lose

Onward1.2.dialogue: Anyways, I was unfortunately unable to secure a boat. There were none left when I got there.

Onward1.2.speaker: Gabriel
Onward1.2.dialogue: Haaa. I guess were take the plane then. We're gonna be here for a while, aren't we?

Opening 2.speaker: Narration
Opening 2.dialogue: We've been waiting for a while here now. It's been 40 minutes and not a singular bus has arrived.

Opening 2.speaker: Joel
Opening 2.dialogue: Damn. Where the hell is this damn bus... It's starting to get cold out here

Opening 2.speaker: Racheal
Opening 2.dialogue: The seas are probably going to be colder. If you cannot handle the chilling breeze here, you'll be hopeless out there when surrounded by water...

Opening 2.speaker: Emilia
Opening 2.dialogue: So, while we're here. Did you guys come with anyone else. I did see you talking to that big guy with the staff back in F Sector

Opening 2.speaker: Kyla
Opening 2.dialogue: He is Stan, one of the High Ranked Supressors Havenus Corperation have hired.

Opening 2.speaker: Jasmine
Opening 2.dialogue: Well, now that we have the time. I know now that High ranked supressors are probably enlisted to keep the peace in here... but how does one become a High Ranked Supressor

Opening 2.speaker: Kyla
Opening 2.dialogue: Well, it's a bit simple. You must past the Test of Vigor, and the only way to even take the test is to be a well known supressor in the crater, have a more than 90% success rate in supression jobs taken, and have a quick skill or factor that only the supressor can do.

Opening 2.speaker: Jasmine
Opening 2.dialogue: Interesting. I assume that Vin, from F Sector, would be considered one due to the two diamond katanas we saw him use alongside his diamond halbeard... but what about Stan

Opening 2.speaker: Kyla
Opening 2.dialogue: Stan is a high ranked supressor because as of now, he is one of the only living people to overcome their own mind.

Opening 2.speaker: Emilia
Opening 2.dialogue: ...And what's that suppose to mean?

Opening 2.speaker: Kyla
Opening 2.dialogue: Do you remember that, at one point, I talked about how Shados exists in everyone, and can be drawn out of someone to turn them into Deformalities

Opening 2.speaker: Jasmine
Opening 2.dialogue: ...yeah.

Opening 2.speaker: Narration
Opening 2.dialogue: I continue listening, noticing that Emilia, who was also eager to hear what Kyla had to say, had taken out a notebook and started writing stuff down in it

Opening 2.speaker: Kyla
Opening 2.dialogue: The source of that Shados is derived directly from the mind, bonding with ones emotions.

Opening 2.speaker: Kyla
Opening 2.dialogue: The more emotionally stable a person is, the clearer their mind. However, as one becomes emotionally unstable through any means, their mind begins to fill with thoughts. Thoughts of violence, thoughts of lossing all care for anyone around them, thoughts only benefiting themselves.

Opening 2.speaker: Kyla
Opening 2.dialogue: From this point, one of 3 things can happen. They can accept said thoughts as true, causing the Shados within them to slowly overcome them, ignore said thoughts and continue living with an unstable mind, or strongly deny the thoughts that attempt to consume them.

Opening 2.speaker: Kyla
Opening 2.dialogue: Choosing to deny will cause the person to purify the shados within them, causing them to break their limits and accend to a high place of power.

Opening 2.speaker: Narration
Opening 2.dialogue: Thinking back to when we left Vin and Stan to fight Gabriel, I could remember his normal suit and staff turning into a lightening spear and armour.

Opening 2.speaker: Jasmine
Opening 2.dialogue: So Stan's tranformation before we left...

Opening 2.speaker: Kyla
Opening 2.dialogue: Yes, Miss Jasmine. The armour and spear of pure lightening he had was a result of this process, his Limit being broken.

Opening 2.speaker: Joel
Opening 2.dialogue: Well, that's quite interesting.

Opening 2.speaker: Emilia
Opening 2.dialogue: W-woah! Joel! I didn't expect you to be one to try and listen to something like this.

Opening 2.speaker: Joel
Opening 2.dialogue: Well I didn't find the rest of the groups conversations to be of interest... so I came to see what you guys were doing.

Opening 2.speaker: Narration
Opening 2.dialogue: Joel's mention of the rest of the group made me realise... I don't really know any of the elite. Well, I know their general attitudes, but thats about it.

Opening 2.speaker: Narration
Opening 2.dialogue: Well, if we're going to be travelling together for a while, I thought, why not try to get to know them better by listening to their conversations

Opening 2.speaker: Macduff
Opening 2.dialogue: No! I'm not gonna tell you were I left mny F Sector armour before I joined here.

Opening 2.speaker: Antonia
Opening 2.dialogue: But it would sell for a lot. Hell, I'll even split the cash with you if you just tell me

Opening 2.speaker: Macduff
Opening 2.dialogue: You don't seem to understand. That armour and that blade are the only remaining remenants of what was once the great F Sector Army. I'm not just going to sell it of for cash that easily

Opening 2.speaker: Snowball
Opening 2.dialogue: Young beast, is anything on your mind.

Opening 2.speaker: The Monster
Opening 2.dialogue: Why do you want to know.

Opening 2.speaker: Snowball
Opening 2.dialogue: Well, you've been silent for a while since we've been waiting for the bus. You must be thinking about something

Opening 2.dialogue: Snowball moves closer to The Monster, attempting to get him to answer her question.

Opening 2.speaker: The Monster
Opening 2.dialogue: Well... the sea's quite a memorable sight... the way it glistens and shines.

Opening 2.speaker: Snowball
Opening 2.dialogue: ...Well, that makes sense. I've taken a bit of a likening to it ever since i've seen it.

Opening 2.dialogue: So, Sherlock, was it. I've heard of that name before. You're the detective that works independent of any organisations or groups

Opening 2.speaker: Sherlock
Opening 2.dialogue: Well, my reputation preceeds me. By the look of your hat, you seem to be among the watchers, but I don't recall you name in the information about the Syndicates

Opening 2.speaker: Goole
Opening 2.dialogue: Well, I am just new. That's all.

Opening 2.speaker: Romeo
Opening 2.dialogue: Hey! Everyone! Down the road

Opening 2.dialogue: Finally. I thought we'd be standing here all day.

Opening 2.dialogue: These buses usually go directly to the port, so we'll get a boat from there.

Opening 2.speaker: Joel
Opening 2.dialogue: ...Well, I wouldn't mind waiting for another...

Opening 2.dialogue: The door of the bus closes behind us as all of them begin to approach

Opening 2.speaker: Joel
Opening 2.dialogue: Well fuck.

Opening 2.speaker: Jasmine
Opening 2.dialogue: Thieves. Everyone. be on guard

The Boat.speaker: Narration

The Boat.dialogue: After throwing the bodies out of the bus, Joel goes into the drivers seat and analyzes

The Boat.dialogue: And what do you want to do.

The Boat.speaker: Narration
The Boat.dialogue: Fighting Malcolm and Ross, defeating Macbeth, fighting the entiguishers and the lady with the fans.

The Boat.speaker: Narration
The Boat.dialogue: Behind them was a tree like structure surrounded by desert.

The Boat.dialogue: Ughh, my head... were are we exactly?

The Boat.speaker: Snowball
The Boat.dialogue: Ohh, Miss Jasmine has awoken!

The Boat.dialogue: Took you long enough

The Boat.dialogue: What-guhh... happened when I was asleep?

The Boat.dialogue: Ughh. Well that would explain why my head is killing me right now.

The Boat.dialogue: Do you have an idea on why this would happen at all.

The Boat.dialogue: Well, I was think about our time in F and W Sector, then I-GAHH!!!

The Boat.dialogue: After a bit, I quickly regain my posture, patting my head as the headache slightly passed

The Boat.dialogue: N-no. I'm fine... I guess.

The Boat.dialogue: Alright, but don't blame me if it gets worse. Anyways, we're officially here!

The Boat.dialogue: I staggeredly get of the bus with everyone else as I attempt to recuperate from the painful headache I had just seconds ago

The Boat.speaker: Kyla
The Boat.dialogue: Ahh, over there, there's still a boat preped to leave. Let's move over there

The Boat.speaker: Jasmine
The Boat.dialogue: Alright... but gimme a sec. My head still hurts like crazy...

The Boat.dialogue: Suddenly, The Monster grabbed me and put me on his shoulder as they walked towards the boat

The Boat.speaker: Jasmine
The Boat.dialogue: H-HEY!!!

The Boat.dialogue: Considering how unwell you are, it was unlikely you would have made it to the boat walking on your own. So, I saw it fit to carry you there

The Boat.speaker: Jasmine
The Boat.dialogue: W-well, i didn't really need the help but... ughh, thanks. When the hell will this headache finally fade

The Boat.dialogue: We should stay prepared. We haven't but a clue on what they are going to attempt next.

The Boat.speaker: Narration
The Boat.dialogue: We enter the living area of the boat, where we are able to rest again.

The Boat.speaker: Narration
The Boat.dialogue: I end up geting laid down on a long couch back first so that I can rest and recover, my headache still causing me trouble

The Boat.dialogue: So, what do we do about her. I don't believe anyone has anything to treat her condition, nor do we have anyone with skills as a doctor

The Boat.speaker: Antonia
The Boat.dialogue: We could probably find medicine for her once we reach the city. It'd be a miracle if they didn't have any of the medicine created in G Sector.

The Boat.speaker: George
The Boat.dialogue: That is... IF we can reach the city

The Boat.speaker: Narration
The Boat.dialogue: George gestures towards the door, signifying the idea that the sailors maybe untrustworthy in their practices

The Boat.speaker: Jasmine
The Boat.dialogue: I'll be fine. It's really just a simple headache. Nothing to fuss much about...

The Boat.speaker: Kyla
The Boat.dialogue: I respect your wishes for us to not worry about you, but if your condition ends up becoming fatal, our mission will be considered a failure...

The Boat.speaker: Romeo
The Boat.dialogue: Heeh... I knew there was a catch. Just had to be.

The Boat.dialogue: Romeo looked directly at Kyla before speaking up again

The Boat.speaker: Romeo
The Boat.dialogue: So... who is it?

The Boat.speaker: Kyla
The Boat.dialogue: ...what are you refering to?

The Boat.speaker: Romeo
The Boat.dialogue: You know the answer to that. Who do you intend to bring back? Why does this mission mean so much to you?

The Boat.speaker: Narration
The Boat.dialogue: Kyla slowly looked down to their hand as they stood, before looking at Romeo and saying...

The Boat.speaker: Kyla
The Boat.dialogue: I wish to fix a mistake...

The Boat.speaker: Narration
The Boat.dialogue: Romeo moved his gaze to me, then the rest of the group, then back at Kyla

The Boat.speaker: Romeo
The Boat.dialogue: I guess that's a sufficient enough answer... whatever...

The Boat.speaker: Sailor
The Boat.dialogue: If you all are done talking, the captain will like to have a talk with all of you

The Boat.speaker: Narration
The Boat.dialogue: All of us look towards the sailor, other Emilia, who was to busy taking pictures of the ocean

The Boat.speaker: Joel
The Boat.dialogue: Emil!

The Boat.speaker: Emilia
The Boat.dialogue: Ohh, sorry... I got a bit carried away there

The Boat.speaker: Narration
The Boat.dialogue: After a short walk, we find our way onto the main deck, with the broad ocean directly in our view as we meet the captain of the ship

The Boat.speaker: Captain
The Boat.dialogue: Ahh, quite the group we have here. And of differing...

The Boat.speaker: Macduff
The Boat.dialogue: What do you want from us.

The Boat.speaker: Narration
The Boat.dialogue: Taken aback by Macduff's sudden accusation, the Captain thought to himself deeply, before speeking up immediately

The Boat.speaker: Captain
The Boat.dialogue: Well, since you first timers actually have some survival instinct, I'll cut straight to the point

The Boat.speaker: Narration
The Boat.dialogue: The Sailors surrounded us, ores pointed to the group in a circle formation

The Boat.speaker: Captain
The Boat.dialogue: We want his gloves.

The Boat.speaker: Narration
The Boat.dialogue: Joel was shocked by the sudden declaration. before immediately denying the offer

The Boat.speaker: Joel
The Boat.dialogue: You can go eat shit if you think I'm giving you these.

The Boat.speaker: Kyla
The Boat.dialogue: Is there any other way we can pay you that isn't his gloves

The Boat.speaker: Captain
The Boat.dialogue: Money is useless for seafarers like us. We already have stacks of it in the bottome deck... although

The Boat.speaker: Narration
The Boat.dialogue: The Captain pondered for a bit before deciding.

The Boat.speaker: Captain
The Boat.dialogue: If you land folk and defeat us in combat, we will respect your side of the bargain, and you will not have to pay us for this trip

The Boat.speaker: Jasmine
The Boat.dialogue: Well-ughh, that should be a better choice. Right guys.

The Boat.speaker: Joel
The Boat.dialogue: Alright, that's a compromise I guess

The Boat.speaker: Narration
The Boat.dialogue: Despite my current condition, I am able to command the elite into battle as the sailors prepare to challenge us

An Attack.speaker: Captain
An Attack.dialogue: Woah, woah. Hold on land dwellers. Looks like someones eager to prove themselves

An Attack.speaker: Kyla
An Attack.dialogue: I believe that we should be allowed to stay on this boat without paying now

An Attack.speaker: Captain
An Attack.dialogue: As if. That was some of the most great battling I've ever expericenced. Most people just give up and are surrounded after the first two waves of sailors, but you all got all the way to me. Ohh, and you with the shock gloves. I can tell why you wanted to keep them. Your amazing with them.

An Attack.speaker: Joel
An Attack.dialogue: ...Thanks... I guess...

An Attack.speaker: Captain
An Attack.dialogue: Here have my card. You semed to be the one in charge of this capable bunch

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: The captain hands me a card with the words 'N Sector Boat Service: Platinum Class Consumer'

An Attack.speaker: Captain
An Attack.dialogue: With that, you should be able to get free boats from our N Sector base

An Attack.speaker: Jasmine
An Attack.dialogue: T-thanks, but... UGhh.

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: My headache suddenly flared without reason as I fall to one knee

An Attack.speaker: Captain
An Attack.dialogue: You okay miss. You sea sick or something

An Attack.speaker: Jasmine
An Attack.dialogue: No no it's... mmph... just headache. That's all.

An Attack.speaker: Kyla
An Attack.dialogue: I believe we should be on our way

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: We mtake our leave from the main deck, heading back down into the living quarter

An Attack.speaker: Jasmine
An Attack.dialogue: O-okay. I'm starting to think this is probably worse than just a headache

An Attack.speaker: Kyla
An Attack.dialogue: I would suggest taking a rest until we get into the city. We should be on this ship for about a day until we reach the city

An Attack.speaker: The Monster
An Attack.dialogue: I think it's best that we all rest on. It's getting dark, and we've basically been fighting for the whole day

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: Everyone makes there own space to attempt to go to sleep as I stare to the ceiling with my eyes open

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: Closing my eyes slowly, I slowly fall asleep, trying to ignore my painful headache

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: I try to take my mind of what had caused my headache, however, all I could see was a heart at some point

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: The heart was beating normally in the rhythm of mine, leaving me to believe that it was my heart

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: Then, suddenly, the heart began to beat louder and louder, confussing me deeply as suddenly a dark looking blade stabbed directly through the heart

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: Suddenly I awoke and was coughing uncontrollably. After a while, I was able to stop myself, looking around and seeing Kyla, with bags under her eyes, walking towards me

An Attack.speaker: Kyla
An Attack.dialogue: M-miss Kyla, are you... alright.

An Attack.speaker: Jasmine
An Attack.dialogue: I don't think so. Along with the headache, my heart hurts slightly now...

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: I took some time to look towards Kyla and notice she wasn't in the best of conditions either. She had some water on her face, she was VERY visibly tired, and was shaky...

An Attack.speaker: Jasmine
An Attack.dialogue: Kyla, you look horrible! How long have you been awake for

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: Kyla turned her head away from me.

An Attack.speaker: Kyla
An Attack.dialogue: Don't spend your time worrying about me, Miss Jasmine. What matters now is that you make a swift recovery

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: Kyla helped me back onto the bed as my drowsiness began to come back

An Attack.speaker: Jasmine
An Attack.dialogue: Alright... just make sure... to get... some... sleep...

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: I drift slowly to sleep again

An Attack.speaker: Context
An Attack.dialogue: After Jasmine had fallen asleep

An Attack.speaker: Context Narration
An Attack.dialogue: Kyla, after seeing Jasmine fall asleep, begins to pace around the room, trying to stay awake

An Attack.speaker: Context Narration
An Attack.dialogue: She looked in the mirror within the room, turning on the tap and splashing water on her face as she muttered to herself

An Attack.speaker: Kyla
An Attack.dialogue: Why won't you just leave me alone. Why won't you... just...

An Attack.speaker: Context Narration
An Attack.dialogue: Against her own will, her body had forced her to finally fall asleep, laying slumped next to the mirror and basin, the tap still running loudly

An Attack.speaker: Context
An Attack.dialogue: Early in the morning

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: I awaken in the morning before everyone else. I've somewhat recovered from what happened yesterday, even though I still have a noticable headache.

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: I get out of bed and look around as I see all the rest of the elite, all sleeping comfortably. I also notice Emilia and Joel, who where both curled together to stay warm

An Attack.speaker: Jasmine
An Attack.dialogue: Huh, I guess everyone fell asleep fine. What about Kyl...

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: I immediately rush towards Kyla, who was slumped on the floor with blood dripping from her forehead. I notice that the tap was off and the window was visibly cracked.

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: I'm able to turn her around, noticing her breathing becoming fainter by the second.

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: I pull out the world key and use it to heal her injuries as she remains asleep.

An Attack.speaker: Jasmine
An Attack.dialogue: Weird. Why would she injure herself like that. I would have heard if someone or something came in.

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: After comfirming that she was alright, I got up and looked out of the window

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: It looked to me like we were getting quite close to the city on the sea at the moment, but there were several ships close to us

An Attack.speaker: Jasmine
An Attack.dialogue: Seems like we're almost at the city. Maybe we'll find Stan the-guhh.

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: My headache seemed to spike again, causing me significant, but manageable pain.

An Attack.speaker: Jasmine
An Attack.dialogue: Well. If there's one thing Kyla was right about... I should probably get myself checked out by a medical expert

An Attack.speaker: Linda
An Attack.dialogue: ...Ughh, jeez. What the hell are you doing up so early, Jas

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: Due to my constant talking, Linda had woken up from her sleep

An Attack.speaker: Jasmine
An Attack.dialogue: Ohh, Linda! Good morning. How you doing?

An Attack.speaker: Linda
An Attack.dialogue: Could be better. Is your headache getting better?

An Attack.speaker: Jasmine
An Attack.dialogue: Well... not really, but I'll be fine.

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: Linda looked around the room, noticing Kyla slumped on the floor next to the basin

An Attack.speaker: Linda
An Attack.dialogue: Well I guess she made that work. On the floor to... Whatever. Are we close to the city yet

An Attack.speaker: Jasmine
An Attack.dialogue: Actually... yeah. Pretty sure I can see it in the...

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: Suddenly, a loud, bomb sounding crash could be heard throughout the entire room

An Attack.speaker: The Elite
An Attack.dialogue: WOAH!!!!

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: As a result of this, all of this Elite immediately awaken from their slumber.

An Attack.speaker: Macduff
An Attack.dialogue: Miss Jasmine, Linda, do you know where that sound came from?

An Attack.speaker: Jasmine
An Attack.dialogue: It seemed to me like It came from the top deck.

An Attack.speaker: Kyla
An Attack.dialogue: I would suggest... waking up Joel and Emilia before we leave... They somehow managed to... *yawn* sleep through whatever that was

An Attack.speaker: Jasmine
An Attack.dialogue: You seem like you didn't sleep at all last night. Are you sure you're okay

An Attack.speaker: Kyla
An Attack.dialogue: I... i'm fine, Miss Jasmine. Just a bit drowsy, that's all...

An Attack.speaker: Jasmine
An Attack.dialogue: Alright... George, could you...

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: As I said the words, George walked over and kicked Joel specifically

An Attack.speaker: George
An Attack.dialogue: Get up, you damn fool

An Attack.speaker: Joel
An Attack.dialogue: Gahh! Hey! I'm up! Jeez...

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: Joel was able to calmly wake up Emilia, and we all made our way to the top deck to see what was going on

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: In the way of our ships and the City was a huge ship with a Skull and Bones Logo on it's main sail, with it's cannons turned towards the ships attempting to reach the city. Beside it were several smaller, more mechanical ships, with Bco. logos on them

An Attack.speaker: Goole
An Attack.dialogue: Birling and Co. Ships...

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: A figure was standing visibly on the biggest ship with what seemed to be a megaphone

An Attack.speaker: Pirate Captain
An Attack.dialogue: As I said before...

An Attack.speaker: Pirate Captain
An Attack.dialogue: ...we have enlisted the assistance of a Gourge Vindicator Syndicate. Please relenquish your ships of any valuables you may have if you would like to enter the city on the sea

An Attack.speaker: Jasmine
An Attack.dialogue: What the hell is going on!?!

An Attack.speaker: Kyla
An Attack.dialogue: Well... by what I can...

An Attack.speaker: Goole
An Attack.dialogue: The Syndicate Birling and Co. had sold out to a group of pirates and is assisting them in robbing anyone that comes near the city on the sea in exchange for 80% of the stolen merchandice

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: We can see the sailors all around, tense as the huge ship begins moving towards ours

An Attack.speaker: Pirate Captain
An Attack.dialogue: And to prove to you, our fellow sailors, that we are not bluffing, we will be going after this ship first

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: As their ship makes contact with ours, several pirates begin to make their way onboard as we all prepare ourselves for combat

Backup.speaker: Narration
Backup.dialogue: As we attempt to subdue their captain, several Birling Ships start to approach ours as the other ships take the commmotion on our ship as an oppourtunity to slip past us and into the city

Backup.speaker: Jasmine
Backup.dialogue: Shit... they're all conveging on our location... And my headache's starting to flare up again

Backup.speaker: Narration
Backup.dialogue: I back away as a Harpoon comes flying through the air that attempted to finish me off in one shot

Backup.speaker: Jasmine
Backup.dialogue: ...Thanks, Goole. They have ranged weapons. Stay on guard, everyone.

Backup.speaker: Narration
Backup.dialogue: The group of Birling and Co. Soliders board our boat, noticably having the tag 'sea farers' on their uniforms

Backup.speaker: Birling and Co. Sea Farer
Backup.dialogue: Please relinquish any valuable present on this ship. This process should not take long.

Backup.speaker: Narration
Backup.dialogue: They point their portable Harpoon Launchers at us before looking through the whole group

Backup.speaker: Birling and Co. Sea Farer
Backup.dialogue: We will also be taking not of the target '4th Sector Watcher Goole' of the 12 Watchers. Elimination of said target will be ensured before we leave with the goods. We assume that you will let us go through with this action

Backup.speaker: Narration
Backup.dialogue: I look towards Goole, who just seems to stare blankly, uninterested in their threats

Backup.speaker: Jasmine
Backup.dialogue: Why do you think we would let you kill him

Backup.speaker: Birling and Co. Sea Farer
Backup.dialogue: As expected. It seems like we must engage the group. Beginning combat.

Backup.speaker: Narration
Backup.dialogue: The Seafarer group move forward to get a better aiming spot as we begin to fight them off

Blackout.speaker: Narration
Blackout.dialogue: As we take down this wave of soliders, more and more seemed to take their place in a never ending wave of soliders

Blackout.speaker: Jasmine
Blackout.dialogue: Damn. There's no end to these guys. HEY! Is anyone still fightin

Blackout.speaker: Kyla
Blackout.dialogue: Miss Jasmine... We are all still fighting the group... for now...

Blackout.speaker: Narration
Blackout.dialogue: Kyla was the only one available to answer my request, as the rest of the combatants on the ship were trying their best to fight off the soliders

Blackout.speaker: Kyla
Blackout.dialogue: Our group is starting to get exhausted, and while the Captain and his Sailors are... still preped to fight, they are outnumbe...

Blackout.speaker: Narration
Blackout.dialogue: Suddenly, a singular image flashed within my head. The figure in white armour leading a charge directly at someone, who I appeared to be in the swift image, with several creatures in glistening light following behind them

Blackout.speaker: Narration
Blackout.dialogue: After said image, My headache started to become unbearably painful, bringing me down to one knee again

Blackout.speaker: Kyla
Blackout.dialogue: Miss Jasmine... Are you alright...

Blackout.speaker: Jasmine
Blackout.dialogue: I'm fine. I just... gotta... take a bit of a rest...

Blackout.speaker: Narration
Blackout.dialogue: At this point, my entire body began to feel a numbing pain similar to the type I felt from my headache as I had slowly began to pass out, seeing only three things before I pass out entirely...

Blackout.speaker: Narration
Blackout.dialogue: ...Several of the Elite being injured, them attempting to drag Goole away with them, and what appeared to be a purple spark sinking the entire Birling and Co. Ship fleet...

Blackout.speaker: Narration
Blackout.dialogue: Then, after that... everything went blank...

Blackout.speaker: Narration
Blackout.dialogue: Ater a while, I finally re-awoke from passing out in the ship, finding myself in a hospital looking area with bright lights.

Blackout.speaker: Narration
Blackout.dialogue: I notice that no one was around me, so I get out of bed and begin to look around as I hear one of the doors open.

Blackout.speaker: Nurse
Blackout.dialogue: Oh, you awake. I was a bit scared for a second because your heartbeat rate was beginning to flatline, but luckyly you pulled through...

Blackout.speaker: Jasmine
Blackout.dialogue: Where am I? Where are the people who sent me here?

Blackout.speaker: Nurse
Blackout.dialogue: Ohh... You mean that Hih Ranked Supressor with the staff.

Blackout.speaker: Jasmine
Blackout.dialogue: Ohh, you mean Stan...

Blackout.speaker: Nurse
Blackout.dialogue: Ahh. Stan was his name. Even is name is perfect...

Blackout.speaker: Narration
Blackout.dialogue: I notice her look flustered for a bit, look away, and then look back at me

Blackout.speaker: Nurse
Blackout.dialogue: B-But on a more serious note... I ran a scan on you to check what could be causing the illness you have, and I notice something weird around your heart.

Blackout.speaker: Narration
Blackout.dialogue: She handed me a notebook with what seemed to be an X-Ray Scan on it, and I took it from her and took a look at her

Blackout.speaker: Narration
Blackout.dialogue: In the Scan is a heart seemingly surronded by a dark substance in a cage like structure steming from a singular point on the surface, specifically the point I had seen the visions of a heart begin stabbed from

Blackout.speaker: Nurse
Blackout.dialogue: That is a scan of your heart. It seems th be surrounded by a dark substance, but my scans have shown that it isn't Shados. Rather, it's something new... something confusing.

Blackout.speaker: Nurse
Blackout.dialogue: While I don't have the skills to deal with this, normal painkillers will work. You see, the pain is caused when whatever this cage like structure is contracts around your heart, which causes the heart pain. However, the headaches are still a mystery, but can still be dealt with the same way. Here.

Blackout.speaker: Narration
Blackout.dialogue: The Nurse hand's me a container that holds a good amount of pills to deal with the pain attacks

Blackout.speaker: Jasmine
Blackout.dialogue: Thanks... what about Stan, and the rest of the group...

Blackout.speaker: Nurse
Blackout.dialogue: They went out into the plaza... b-by the way. If you ever meet up with him, tell Stan that I said hi...

Blackout.speaker: Jasmine
Blackout.dialogue: ...I'll get your message across

Blackout.speaker: Narration
Blackout.dialogue: Well she's obsessed

Blackout.speaker: Narration
Blackout.dialogue: I leave the room, seeing a huge plaza with several different shops and vendors trying to sell stuff to the wave of passing people

Blackout.speaker: Stan
Blackout.dialogue: Ohh, would you look at that. Here I thought I would have to look for someone that could use the world key again. You actually pulled through, huh...

Blackout.speaker: Kyla
Blackout.dialogue: It is a miracle that you're ok, Miss Jasmine. Racheal had gone out looking for some medicine for you just a bit ago, but hasn't returned yet

Blackout.speaker: Narration
Blackout.dialogue: I look through the group, noticing that not only Racheal, but a few others were missing from the group aswell

Blackout.speaker: Jasmine
Blackout.dialogue: Alright. I know about Racheal, but what about Romeo and Macduff? Where did they go?

Blackout.speaker: Kyla
Blackout.dialogue: THose two were the ones in charge of finding a suitable ship to travel to our location.

Blackout.speaker: Jasmine
Blackout.dialogue: What about Joel and Emilia?

Blackout.speaker: Kyla
Blackout.dialogue: For starter's, both are now officially members of the Havenus Elite, and they're out now taking pictures for Emilia's memoria of the crater

Blackout.speaker: Linda
Blackout.dialogue: We're here to ensure no one attempted to assassinate you while we were here. But now that your alright and awaken, we should probably go look for the rest of the group

Blackout.speaker: Jasmine
Blackout.dialogue: Alright. Where do we need to go first?

Blackout.speaker: Kyla
Blackout.dialogue: It's probably best to get Emilia and Joel first. Last I saw them, they went left, which now is the opposite direction the crowd.

Blackout.speaker: Jasmine
Blackout.dialogue: Alright. We can just push through the crowd...

Blackout.speaker: George
Blackout.dialogue: ...And get everything we have that is of any value stolen so they can buy more stuff. It's up to you, Miss Jasmine, but we'll have to fight off the people in the crowd if we want to get past

Blackout.speaker: Jasmine
Blackout.dialogue: Huh. Well that's just great, isn't it? Isn't the hallway suppose to go both ways

Blackout.speaker: Tia
Blackout.dialogue: They've taken up the space for both back and forth. It's either wait here and risk missing the boat that Romeo and Macduff are currently gatting for the group, or push through the crowd through violent force.

Blackout.speaker: Jasmine
Blackout.dialogue: Well, guess our hands are tied. Everyone, get ready for combat! We're heading out now!

Blackout.speaker: Stan
Blackout.dialogue: You definately sound like someone who was close to dying. No matter, I'll go look for Macduff and Romeo then. Goodluck out there

Blackout.speaker: Jasmine
Blackout.dialogue: Of course you...

Blackout.speaker: Narration
Blackout.dialogue: Out of the corner of my eye, I notice someone watching us who didn't look like a normal shopper, but they skittered away before I could get a proper glance at them

Accusation.speaker: Jasmine
Accusation.dialogue: Finally! That took way to long. So this is where you thought they went.

Accusation.speaker: Kyla
Accusation.dialogue: I am sure of if, Jasmine. This Museum is the most likely place for them to be in.

Accusation.speaker: Narration
Accusation.dialogue: We enter a museum, and are immediately approached by a guide patron with leaflets in their hand.

Accusation.speaker: Museum Guide
Accusation.dialogue: Hello, and welcome to the musée du cratère. That's french for Museum of the Crater. A tour is currently about to start soon, would you like to join?

Accusation.speaker: Jasmine
Accusation.dialogue: That's a nice offer, but we're busy right now. Did you see a girl with a camera and a dude with electrical high-tech gloves in here

Accusation.speaker: Museum Guide
Accusation.dialogue: Ohh! Yes, infact! I did. They're actually part of the tour that's about to begin, so you can go met them quickly if you wish to join.

Accusation.speaker: Narration
Accusation.dialogue: I look to Kyla, who gives me a swift nod, then I turn to the Guide

Accusation.speaker: Jasmine
Accusation.dialogue: Alright. We'll join the tour

Accusation.speaker: Museum Guide
Accusation.dialogue: Ohh... excellent! Right this way please.

Accusation.speaker: Narration
Accusation.dialogue: We follow the tour guide through the museum as he takes us to a sphere shapes object with an open door leading inside it

Accusation.speaker: Museum Guide
Accusation.dialogue: Enter the orb, and with the magic of N Sector, experience the history of our Crater...

Accusation.speaker: Narration
Accusation.dialogue: As we enter the orb, the guide closes the door behind us as we met with the rest of the people in the tour

Accusation.speaker: Emilia
Accusation.dialogue: Ohh, hey there, Jasmine. I'm glad you're okay. Joel was worried sick when you passed out

Accusation.speaker: Joel
Accusation.dialogue: No I... well, I was a little bit worried.

Accusation.speaker: Jasmine
Accusation.dialogue: Aww, that's cute.

Accusation.speaker: Joel
Accusation.dialogue: Shut up...

Accusation.speaker: Narration
Accusation.dialogue: Among the other people within the area that seemed like average people, I could see a man in pure black who had his arms crossed and was positioned away from everyone else. They looked similar to the person watching us at the Medical Area, but that could just be coincidence...

Accusation.speaker: Narration
Accusation.dialogue: Suddenly a megaphone activated loudly as the glass planes visible within the orb began to shift to black

Accusation.speaker: Voice from the Megaphone
Accusation.dialogue: Welcome visitors to our brand new tour du monde attraction, were you get to learn the history of our beautiful home called a Crater, supported by funding from Divinus Conjoint for historical accuracy

Accusation.speaker: Narration
Accusation.dialogue: The surroundings shifted to the image of a wasteland with a huge Crater around it. On the edge of it was a man whose figure I couldn't recognise

Accusation.speaker: Voice from the Megaphone
Accusation.dialogue: ahemm: 'In the beginning, when the world around this place had fallen to it's own hubris, a man who went by James J. Divinus found the Crater, and, using his funding from whoever his higher-ups were, he turned an large, un-even hole in the land into a utopia, were we could all live in peace.'

Accusation.speaker: Voice from the Megaphone
Accusation.dialogue: 'However, a plague soon came over this utopia while we lived our lives here, a plague of shadow, darkness, and evil.'

Accusation.speaker: Narration
Accusation.dialogue: The glass planes shifted to become a figure made of dark substnace with several handless black creatures around it.

Accusation.speaker: Voice from the Megaphone
Accusation.dialogue: 'The Scourge, the Angel of Death, decended upon the land, and had begun to transform the people into the creatures known as the Handless Demons. However, thanks to Mr Divinus' intelligence and the strength of the Judges, they were able to push back the Scoorge'

Accusation.speaker: Voice from the Megaphone
Accusation.dialogue: 'Unfortunately, however, before he was dispelled, the Scoorge had binded itself with everyone here, creating the shados that is bound to our memories... but that is a story for another time.'

Accusation.speaker: Narration
Accusation.dialogue: The glass planes shifted to a map of W Sector

Accusation.speaker: Voice from the Megaphone
Accusation.dialogue: 'Worry is irrelevant in the fresh calm waters of W Sector.' And that is the end of the transcript provided, please proceed through the door to your right to see more in the museum

Accusation.speaker: Narration
Accusation.dialogue: Another door, oppositely sided to the one we entered from, opened as the glass planes became glass again.

Accusation.speaker: Jasmine
Accusation.dialogue: Hey, Kyla. Where the hell does Havenus fit in all of that.

Accusation.speaker: Kyla
Accusation.dialogue: They were created long after the establishment of the 12 Sectors due to their disagreement with how Divinus functioned. I believe you will be able to find more information in the main museum if you are curious

Accusation.speaker: Emilia
Accusation.dialogue: Ohh yeah! were going into the museum.

Accusation.speaker: Joel
Accusation.dialogue: ...I mean... I'm not against it but... don't we have somewhere to be.

Accusation.speaker: Kyla
Accusation.dialogue: Well, we can always come back here after we're done collecting the spectral core if you guys want more pictures

Accusation.speaker: Emilia
Accusation.dialogue: Alright...

Accusation.speaker: Narration
Accusation.dialogue: As we spoke, the door we came in from opens again

Accusation.speaker: Museum Guide
Accusation.dialogue: If you wish to leave, follow me.

Accusation.speaker: Jasmine
Accusation.dialogue: Wait. You can listen to everything going on in here?

Accusation.speaker: Museum Guide
Accusation.dialogue: How else would we find anyone trying to organise crime in the Plaza. Company code required by Divinus. Now, au revoir, et passe une bonne journée

Accusation.speaker: Narration
Accusation.dialogue: We exit the orb and make our way to the exit of the Musuem, when we're approached by a gift shop owner there

Accusation.speaker: Sketchy Owner
Accusation.dialogue: NOW HOLD ON JUST A SECOND.

Accusation.speaker: Narration
Accusation.dialogue: They walk directly to Joel, staring them down.

Accusation.speaker: Sketchy Owner
Accusation.dialogue: You left my shop without paying for those gloves, didn't you

Accusation.speaker: Joel
Accusation.dialogue: ...No I didn't. Sorry, but I don't even know yo...

Accusation.speaker: Sketchy Owner
Accusation.dialogue: However! I am a forgiving person. I will give you the oppurtunity to return it to my excellent gift shop, or there will be concequences

Accusation.speaker: The Monster
Accusation.dialogue: And what are you going to do.

Accusation.speaker: Narration
Accusation.dialogue: The Monster looked directly down at him, cracking his knuckles slowly as the Owner backed away a little.

Accusation.speaker: Sketchy Owner
Accusation.dialogue: W-well, I'll call an Android, and it'll make quick work of...

Accusation.speaker: The Monster
Accusation.dialogue: I don't see it yet, do I

Accusation.speaker: Jasmine
Accusation.dialogue: Android, what are they exactly

Accusation.speaker: Kyla
Accusation.dialogue: W Sector's Anti Theft Andriods. Can be called on anyone within the Plaza that owns a shop, but are significantly weaker than the Anti Theft Supressors that they hire

Accusation.speaker: Sketchy Owner
Accusation.dialogue: FINE. If you wish. ahmm... THEY'RE HERE TO ROB ME

Accusation.speaker: Museum Guide
Accusation.dialogue: Ohh, please. As if they would still answer with all the false situations you've called them for, you idiot. Get a gri...

Accusation.speaker: Narration
Accusation.dialogue: The museum guide was crushed to bits as a steel machiene dropped down on top of them. All the attractions in the museum were all surrounded by metal cylinders to protect them from the fight that was about to begin

Accusation.speaker: Anti Theft Android
Accusation.dialogue: THIEVES DETECTED. INITIATING ELIMINATION PROTOCAL_

Accusation.speaker: The Monster
Accusation.dialogue: Ohh this is gonna be good...

Jack Merridew.speaker: Narration
Jack Merridew.dialogue: We all were taken aback by the unexpected explosion of the Android

Jack Merridew.speaker: Jasmine
Jack Merridew.dialogue: I-is everyone alright

Jack Merridew.speaker: The Monster
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Yeah, we're good. But I don't think he is

Jack Merridew.speaker: Narration
Jack Merridew.dialogue: The Monster pointed towards the Gift Shop owner, who was now no more than a smouldering corpse after trying to get in the way of the Android

Jack Merridew.speaker: Jasmine
Jack Merridew.dialogue: ...Well, now that that's dealt wi...

Jack Merridew.speaker: Narration
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Suddenly, a loud sound of someone slowly clapping could be heard as we all turn towards the source of the sound

Jack Merridew.speaker: Narration
Jack Merridew.dialogue: It was the man who was standing on their own in the orb, and they had seemingly followed us out of it without anyone knowing
Well, well. Now that was an inpressive showing if I've ever seen one.

Jack Merridew.speaker: Jasmine
Jack Merridew.dialogue: ...Does anyone know this guy?

Jack Merridew.speaker: Narration
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Almost simultaneously, the entire group erupted into a symphony of no's that answered my question

Jack Merridew.speaker: Jasmine
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Then who the hell are you?
...Well, you don't need to know that... yet. I'll be on my way now. Besides, I've already gotten what I want from you guys

Jack Merridew.speaker: Narration
Jack Merridew.dialogue: The man swiftly moved away, as if they had somewhere to be at the moment.

Jack Merridew.speaker: Jasmine
Jack Merridew.dialogue: H-hey, where do you think you're going!

Jack Merridew.speaker: Kyla
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Jasmine. While I would normally suggest not giving chase, they could pose a threat to Havenus as a whole depending on the information they have chosen to gather. It would be wise for us to investigate

Jack Merridew.speaker: Jasmine
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Alright everyone, let's get ready to... hey, wait a minute

Jack Merridew.speaker: Narration
Jack Merridew.dialogue: I notice that there is no longer a parrade of shoppers in the hallways

Jack Merridew.speaker: Jasmine
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Ohh yeah! they left after the Android appeared. Well that makes this much easier, then. Everyone! Follow him!

Jack Merridew.speaker: Narration
Jack Merridew.dialogue: We follow the mysterious figure until he crosses into a darker area of the plaza. However, as we followed, we didn't end up finding them. Instead, we found something else...

Jack Merridew.speaker: Narration
Jack Merridew.dialogue: It was Racheal... well, her corpse. Notably, she had a deep stab wound in her neck as well as several injuries to the rest of her body

Jack Merridew.speaker: Jasmine
Jack Merridew.dialogue: WHAT THE...

Jack Merridew.speaker: Narration
Jack Merridew.dialogue: I immediately rush towards her while she was on the ground, using the world key to heal her injuries and re-awaken her.

Jack Merridew.speaker: Racheal
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Ughh... Jasmine? Your alright? Well... that's a relief at lea...

Jack Merridew.speaker: Jasmine
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Yeah, yeah, yeah, I'm okay, that's fine. WHAT HAPPENED TO YOU?

Jack Merridew.speaker: Narration
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Racheal got up from the floor and dusted herself off before beginning to answer

Jack Merridew.speaker: Racheal
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Well...

Jack Merridew.speaker: Context
Jack Merridew.dialogue: While Jasmine was still asleep

Jack Merridew.speaker: Context Narration
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Racheal was fighting past the crowd looking for something to help out Jasmine

Jack Merridew.speaker: Racheal
Jack Merridew.dialogue: That nurse is definately not qualified, maybe I can find someone else that can help out Jasmine... Ohh, over there.

Jack Merridew.dialogue: Racheal found a general purpose store and entered before asking if they had any medicine

Jack Merridew.speaker: Shop Owner
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Sorry, ma'am. We don't have any as of now.

Jack Merridew.speaker: Racheal
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Ohh... well I can always check elsewhere

Jack Merridew.speaker: Context Narration
Jack Merridew.dialogue: As she turned around to leave, she ended up bumping into someone

Jack Merridew.speaker: Racheal
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Ohh, my apologies. I didn't see you ther...
Ahh, well look who it is...

Jack Merridew.speaker: Context Narration

Jack Merridew.speaker: Racheal
Jack Merridew.dialogue: ...Merridew

Jack Merridew.speaker: Jack Merridew
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Daww, wus wrong? Scared of little ol me, Racheal. Well, not like I was expecting us to ever met again, and here of all places.

Jack Merridew.speaker: Racheal
Jack Merridew.dialogue: If that's the case, then I'll be on my way...

Jack Merridew.speaker: Jack Merridew
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Woah, woah, woah, and end the reunion so quickly? Roger, get the rest of em. Tell em we found her

Jack Merridew.speaker: Roger
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Alright.

Jack Merridew.speaker: Narration
Jack Merridew.dialogue: As the rest of Jack group funnel in, Racheal begins to speak up to him

Jack Merridew.speaker: Racheal
Jack Merridew.dialogue: So this is what you did to the choir, turned it into your own personal hunting group. I can tell you never changed

Jack Merridew.speaker: Jack Merridew
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Says the one tightly gripping that little spear in their hands. Besides, there's still a beast there, something no one's ever seen on that island...

Jack Merridew.speaker: Racheal
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Do you HONESTLY believe that the really even was a beast there?

Jack Merridew.speaker: Jack Merridew
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Don't you?

Jack Merridew.speaker: Jack Merridew
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Excatly. We're going there to kill it and bring it back. Hunting a creature like that would earn us quite the fortune

Jack Merridew.speaker: Racheal
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Enough with the excuses. You want to kill it simply because you can, don't you.

Jack Merridew.speaker: Context Narration
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Roger turned to Jack, who was a bit more silent after that last line from Racheal, but Jack responded after a bit

Jack Merridew.speaker: Jack Merridew
Jack Merridew.dialogue: What if I do simply just want to kill whatever it is. What if it's because I can. What does that even matter to you.

Jack Merridew.speaker: Racheal
Jack Merridew.dialogue: ...I believe we're done here. Now we can simply move on fro...

Jack Merridew.speaker: Jack Merridew
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Move on, huh.

Jack Merridew.speaker: Context Narration
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Jack moved closer to her, puting one of his hands in his left pocket

Jack Merridew.speaker: Jack Merridew
Jack Merridew.dialogue: You just want to move on from it, don't you. Move on from what WE did to Simon, and what happened to...

Jack Merridew.speaker: Context Narration
Jack Merridew.dialogue: In a fit of rage, Racheal swung her Spear to slash at Jack, to which he blocked with a Knife that he pulled out of his left pocket.

Jack Merridew.speaker: Jack Merridew
Jack Merridew.dialogue: There it is. There's the rage. You still care about them, don't you

Jack Merridew.speaker: Racheal
Jack Merridew.dialogue: ...SHUT UP!

Jack Merridew.speaker: Context Narration
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Some members of Jacks group began to approach, but Jack stopped them

Jack Merridew.speaker: Jack Merridew
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Aww, what's wrong? Did I strike a nerve there?

Jack Merridew.speaker: Context Narration
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Racheal had begun to raise her spear, but after some contemplation

Jack Merridew.speaker: Context Narration
Jack Merridew.dialogue: She lowered her spear and pushed her way past Jack atteempting to exit the shop

Jack Merridew.speaker: Racheal
Jack Merridew.dialogue: I need to look for something that I could use to help Jasmi...

Jack Merridew.speaker: Context Narration
Jack Merridew.dialogue: In a sudden burst of speed, Jack slashed her in the back with his knife before kicking her out of the shop and onto the ground

Jack Merridew.speaker: Context Narration
Jack Merridew.dialogue: After regaining her composure, Racheal prepared herself for battle

Jack Merridew.speaker: Jack Merridew
Jack Merridew.dialogue: There we go. Men, don't interfere, I'll deal with her myself

Reawakening.speaker: Jack Merridew
Reawakening.dialogue: Heh, what's the matter. This isn't the 'you' I remember, Racheal...

Reawakening.speaker: Context Narration
Reawakening.dialogue: Racheal had several injuries from her fight with Jack, while Jack, although also injured, was seemingly unphased

Reawakening.speaker: Jack Merridew
Reawakening.dialogue: ...Maybe if you were this a scared little girl and had just left us alone...

Reawakening.speaker: Racheal
Reawakening.dialogue: Shut... Up...

Reawakening.speaker: Jack Merridew
Reawakening.dialogue: ...Maybe he would still be alive.

Reawakening.speaker: Context Narration
Reawakening.dialogue: In furious rage, Racheal rushed directly towards Jack with her spear preped

Reawakening.speaker: Jack Merridew
Reawakening.dialogue: You see, that's your problem...

Reawakening.speaker: Context Narration
Reawakening.dialogue: In a swifter motion, Jack avoided her Spear strike and drove his knife into her neck.

Reawakening.speaker: Jack Merridew
Reawakening.dialogue: You care way to much about being normal in a world like this...

Reawakening.speaker: Context Narration
Reawakening.dialogue: Jack then kicked her away and cleaned his knife before leaving, with Roger close beside him

Reawakening.speaker: Jack Merridew
Reawakening.dialogue: Hide the body in the corner over there in that corner. Also, Roger, find anyone else with the same uniform as her. Maybe lead them here so that they know that they lost a...

Reawakening.speaker: Context Narration
Reawakening.dialogue: After a while of him talking, Racheal had finally passed out from the blood loss

Reawakening.speaker: Context
Reawakening.dialogue: Present time. Racheal skipped a few bits in her re-telling of the story

Reawakening.speaker: Racheal
Reawakening.dialogue: And that's about what happened

Reawakening.speaker: Jasmine
Reawakening.dialogue: So you're telling me that you found an old friend of your's called Jack while you were looking for resources to help me, he attacked you, you fought, and he killed you?

Reawakening.speaker: Racheal
Reawakening.dialogue: ...Yes.

Reawakening.speaker: Jasmine
Reawakening.dialogue: You know what, whatever. All that matters is that you're okay and you're here with us. We're looking for Macduf and Romeo.

Reawakening.speaker: Racheal
Reawakening.dialogue: Ohh yeah, they're outside right now looking for a boat. The port should be close by.

Reawakening.speaker: Jasmine
Reawakening.dialogue: Alright, let's...

Reawakening.speaker: Narration
Reawakening.dialogue: As I turn to leave, I notice that the wave of Shoppers are back again

Reawakening.speaker: Jasmine
Reawakening.dialogue: Ohh, you gotta be... You know what? Whatever... let's just go through them already...

Fire and Ice.speaker: Jasmine
Fire and Ice.dialogue: Finally, we're through them...

Fire and Ice.dialogue: Took you all long enough. Was getting tired of waiting.

Fire and Ice.dialogue: Waiting for you? It's pretty obvious.

Fire and Ice.dialogue: You're suppose to be looking for Macduff and Romeo

Fire and Ice.dialogue: Ohh yeah... I forgot about that, actually...

Fire and Ice.speaker: Jasmine

Fire and Ice.dialogue: The ship to our left over there...

Fire and Ice.dialogue: About right here on the map is the island we need to be at. The trip should take about an hour

Fire and Ice.speaker: Jasmine

Fire and Ice.speaker: Narration
Fire and Ice.dialogue: Both turn to the source of my voice.

Fire and Ice.speaker: Romeo
Fire and Ice.dialogue: Seems like you've made a swift recovery, Miss Jasmine. We've readied the boat and given the crew the location of the spectral cores energy.

Fire and Ice.dialogue: Alright, alright. Trust in us. We got it from here.

Fire and Ice.speaker: Stan
Fire and Ice.dialogue: Well, that's a relief

Fire and Ice.dialogue: Stan, who didn't even try to follow us, suddenly appeared behind us

Fire and Ice.speaker: Jasmine
Fire and Ice.dialogue: WOAH!!!!

Fire and Ice.dialogue: Seems like you guys got yourselves covered. Anyways, I've got other work from Havenus to attend to. Stay safe, and don't get youself killed out there.

Fire and Ice.speaker: Narration
Fire and Ice.dialogue: Stan dissappeared in a flash of electricity again.

Fire and Ice.speaker: Jasmine
Fire and Ice.dialogue: ...Okay...

Fire and Ice.dialogue: Wow, looks like you all have your own rooms, huh...

Fire and Ice.speaker: Jasmine
Fire and Ice.dialogue: Well... you two can both share my room. It's only an hour, so it should only be for a while

Fire and Ice.dialogue: Ohh. Thanks Jasmine.

Fire and Ice.speaker: Narration
Fire and Ice.dialogue: I open the door as I get a view of my room...

Fire and Ice.speaker: Narration
Fire and Ice.dialogue: ...It was a white coloured simple room, finished off with a couch to the side and a bed next to a window leading to a view of the see.

Fire and Ice.speaker: Jasmine
Fire and Ice.dialogue: Well, what do you guys think.

Fire and Ice.speaker: Joel
Fire and Ice.dialogue: Think about what?

Fire and Ice.speaker: Jasmine
Fire and Ice.dialogue: You guys have been a member of the Elite for about a day now, counting from the time you joined after we defeated that Fan-Weilding lady. what do you think of the Elite

Fire and Ice.speaker: Emilia
Fire and Ice.dialogue: Well, It's allowed me to take all the pictures I want of stuff in the city of the sea, and maybe other places once we got further

Fire and Ice.speaker: Joel
Fire and Ice.dialogue: Honestly, I just like to be constantly on the move... and being part of the Elite is an easy way to do that

Fire and Ice.speaker: Jasmine
Fire and Ice.dialogue: That's great, but speaking of the Fan-Weilding Lady. It seemed like she was after the two of you for some reason. Do you know why?

Fire and Ice.speaker: Joel
Fire and Ice.dialogue: Well...

Fire and Ice.dialogue: Oh my... can we go on a singular ship without being attacked. Whatever, we should check out who that is

Fire and Ice.dialogue: Emilia, you stay down here...

Fire and Ice.speaker: Emilia
Fire and Ice.dialogue: But why? I want to see who it is aswell

Fire and Ice.dialogue: Emilia was already about to get up from bed when Joel started speaking

Fire and Ice.speaker: Joel
Fire and Ice.dialogue: I know, but you don't really have any combat experience, so it would be advised that you stay here. Come to the main deck if anything goes wrong, okay?

Fire and Ice.speaker: Emilia
Fire and Ice.dialogue: ...Fine.

Fire and Ice.dialogue: Director Jasmine, Joel. I assume you two heard the crash from above as well.

Fire and Ice.speaker: Jasmine
Fire and Ice.dialogue: Yeah... What is it with this Sector and people attacking ships anyways.

Fire and Ice.speaker: Kyla
Fire and Ice.dialogue: We can't ponder for that for long. Considering we're on a Havenus boat, the attackers are most likely Divinus.

Fire and Ice.speaker: Narration
Fire and Ice.dialogue: We all move up to the main deck of the ship as we find a familiar face, alongside a new one who was a being made completely of Ice. Both were in similar suits with highlights in the same colour as themselves, being red and cyan respectively

Fire and Ice.speaker: Lenuff
Fire and Ice.dialogue: Ahh. If it isn't my favourite group of traitors. I would say I'm suprised, but your logo on this ship is literally visible from way up in the sky.

Fire and Ice.speaker: Macduff
Fire and Ice.dialogue: What are you doing here, child?

Fire and Ice.speaker: Lenuff
Fire and Ice.dialogue: Isn't it obvious, you murderer. I'm here for revenge from killing her, my mother. The fact that you think you can es...

Fire and Ice.speaker: Tybalt
Fire and Ice.dialogue: We don't have time for the whole speech, Lenuff. Basically were here for the...

Fire and Ice.dialogue: Tybalt stopped talking after taking notice to someone in our group. And, by following his stare, I found out that it was...

Fire and Ice.speaker: Tybalt
Fire and Ice.dialogue: Well, well, well. I didn't find you to be the heroic type, child of montague

Fire and Ice.speaker: Romeo
Fire and Ice.dialogue: ...Tybalt.

Fire and Ice.speaker: Tybalt
Fire and Ice.dialogue: You know, I was going to just leave after stealing your map and pick up Lenuff once he's done fighting you folk. But now... I think I'll humour his idea of justice if it means I get to kill you...

Fire and Ice.speaker: Romeo
Fire and Ice.dialogue: Someone's let himself go since we last met. Here I thought you were loyal to the Capulet only, and now you're here, working for Divinus

Fire and Ice.speaker: Tybalt
Fire and Ice.dialogue: And why do you think that is? this body of ice is not mine to choose. You know what you did to me... you turned me into this...

Fire and Ice.speaker: Romeo
Fire and Ice.dialogue: And whose fault was it for killing him...

Fire and Ice.speaker: Narration
Fire and Ice.dialogue: Romeo stared directly at Tybalt as he stood before Tybalt suddenly disappeared.

Fire and Ice.speaker: Narration
Fire and Ice.dialogue: I began to look around for a bit before I sensed something slowly approach me, then a strong chilling feeling around my neck as Romeo moved as well

Fire and Ice.speaker: Narration
Fire and Ice.dialogue: Suddenly Tybalt had an ice knife to my neck while Romeo had his rapier to his.

Fire and Ice.speaker: Romeo
Fire and Ice.dialogue: The fight is between us, Tybalt. Leave them out of this

Fire and Ice.speaker: Tybalt
Fire and Ice.dialogue: Our data confirms that they are behind your revival ability, so eliminating them...

Fire and Ice.speaker: Narration
Fire and Ice.dialogue: The Monster then shoulder bashed Tybalt away from me, knocking him back as he seemingly dashed back to Lenuff's side

Fire and Ice.speaker: Lenuff
Fire and Ice.dialogue: Heck yeah. I've been waiting for this. Let's do this

Fire and Ice.speaker: Narration
Fire and Ice.dialogue: Lenuff drew the Flare Sword and Tybalt formed a rapier of ice as well as weilding his Frost Dagger, then they both rush at the group prepared for combat

Memory.speaker: Lenuff
Memory.dialogue: Damnit....

Memory.dialogue: Both Lenuff and Tybalt were swiftly beaten down.

Memory.dialogue: The mission has proven unsuccessful... ahh, well, what's the point. Lenuff, we're leaving

Memory.dialogue: Hold on

Memory.speaker: Narration
Memory.dialogue: ...Before swiftly striking it into the ship, causing it to cut in half

Memory.dialogue: Alright, let's go

Memory.dialogue: They destroyed the ship in a single attack

Memory.dialogue: Emilia is below us. I need to go check on her...

Memory.speaker: Racheal
Memory.dialogue: EVERYONE, GRAB ONTO SOMETHING OR ELSE THE WAVE'LL...

Memory.dialogue: I reawaken a bit injured and dazed on a sand bed as I slowly get up from the ground to see that I was on an Island.

Memory.dialogue: Jeez... What the hell is wrong with...

Memory.dialogue: ...my leg...

Memory.dialogue: I notice a huge bit of steel shrapnel in my leg that stopped me from walking, which probably got in after the crash.

Memory.speaker: Jasmine
Memory.dialogue: Well... I guess... I won't be... going anywhere...

Memory.dialogue: I lay down on the sandy beach, looking upto the sun before getting tired and deciding to fall alseep while waiting for someone to help me.

Memory.speaker: Narration
Memory.dialogue: Unlike my last endeavours to try and rest, I am able to sleep without much disturbance until I reawaken not on the sand bed, but somewhere within the forest

Memory.dialogue: Slowly pushing myself upwards from laying down fo a decent while, I notice that the shrapnel has been removed from my leg, it now being replaced by a makeshift bandage of leaf and some cloth

Memory.dialogue: Looking around the area, I notice the person who found me. It was Joel. He had torn off a bit of his jacket to make the bandage around my leg, and was looking at a still unconcious Emilia on the ground while sitting next to a fire

Memory.dialogue: Seeming to notice me watching, he turned around swiftly

Memory.speaker: Joel
Memory.dialogue: Ohh, miss Jasmine. Your awaken again.

Memory.speaker: Jasmine
Memory.dialogue: Yeah, and somewhat in one piece

Memory.dialogue: I get on my feet, noticing that  I can walk without a limp again as I go to check on Emilia

Memory.speaker: Jasmine
Memory.dialogue: Is she okay. She was still inside when the ship began to shore up

Memory.dialogue: She's fine, but I noticed something weird about her once I found her on the beach

Memory.speaker: Jasmine
Memory.dialogue: Well, what was it.

Memory.dialogue: Joel, initially knocked out from the crash, stirred awake and began to wake up

Memory.dialogue: Before the dead animals was Emilia, not a drop of blood on her hands as she stood motionlessly, staring at the dead predators.

Memory.dialogue: E-Emilia?

Memory.dialogue: The girl slowly turned around, Joel noticing her face shift from one of dread slowly to one of relief

Memory.dialogue: Joel...

Memory.dialogue: Your alright...

Memory.dialogue: With that, the girl fell on unconcious, Joel quickly rushing to her aid when she fell over

Memory.dialogue: Joel had not left out any details in his account

Memory.dialogue: But she couldn't fight before. How did she even kill those animals to protect you

Memory.dialogue: That's the part I don't understand...
...I believe I have the answer you're looking for

Memory.dialogue: Me and Joel look to the source of the voice. it was Kyla, with Linda and Sherlock next to her. It seems like they came to look for her

Memory.dialogue: With the account you gave, the most likely answer is that she was experiencing the early symptoms of alteration

Memory.dialogue: Kyla! Linda! Sherlock! You found us. Also, what's alteration?

Memory.dialogue: Do you remember when I talked about how Shados exists in everyone, and how it can be purified.

Memory.dialogue: I nod my head in comfirmation, remembering the conversation from yesterday about why Stan was a High Rannked Supressor

Memory.dialogue: I also mentioned that a person can be consumed by the Shados within them by giving into the negative thoughts caused by them. Memory.dialogue: We both get up, Joel carrying Emilia due to her being unconcious, and we follow them to the area in which the rest of the group was waiting for us

Memory.speaker: Narration
Memory.dialogue: It was a group of seemingly abandoned and left to time dwelling areas that the rest had repurposed into a temporary area of residence as they recuperated from the attack

Memory.dialogue: Noticing us approaching, Antonia approached us with a smile

Memory.speaker: Antonia
Memory.dialogue: Ohh goodness, you're awake. The Monster was worried sick about you three when we couldn't find you

Memory.dialogue: I WAS NOT!! I was just concerned for them, that's all

Memory.dialogue: The Monster swiftly moved towards Antonia after hearing her

Memory.dialogue: Awww, well isn't that cute, huh?

Memory.dialogue: You know what... whatever. What's wrong with the girl?

Memory.dialogue: Overwhelmed herself due to the effects of Alteration... I don't know what caused it though, but it seemed to calm her down when she saw that I was okay for some reason...

Memory.dialogue: I notice Racheal was seperate from the rest of the group, choosing to stay as far away from the living area in which we stayed as possible, also noticing that they looked uneasy

Memory.dialogue: After hearing her name, the Aero started to calm down slowly

Memory.dialogue: GAHHHHHHHH!!

Memory.dialogue: H-Hey! Snowball!!

Memory.dialogue: The group quickly follow to dragged bodies, with Joel resting Emilia on a nearby rock as he followed the rope
