Memory.dialogue: Suddenly, with a powerful kick to the head from a injured but very much not dead Snowball, the Beast Hunter was killed in an instant

Memory.speaker: Beast Hunter 1
Memory.dialogue: WHAT THE!

Memory.speaker: Narration
Memory.dialogue: In a swift motion as the other one began preparing to attack with their spear, Snowball grabbed them by the neck and pinned them to a tree before crushing their neck with all their remaining strength, killing the second Beast Hunter before collapsing to the floor again.

Memory.speaker: Narration
Memory.dialogue: Slightly stunned but acting quickly, I approach and use the World Key to revive her once more, the feeling the intense pain of the spear they had made use of resonating through my entire body

Memory.speaker: Narration
Memory.dialogue: Snowball reawoke, noticing me staggering back from the unusually high amount of pain.

Memory.speaker: Snowball
Memory.dialogue: Miss Jasmine. Are you alright.

Memory.speaker: Jasmine
Memory.dialogue: I'm alright. What the hell were those spears made of

Memory.speaker: Racheal
Memory.dialogue: They are made of a special type of steel, of which it's purpose is to cause the person injured to experience much more pain than they normally would from their injuries.

Memory.speaker: Narration
Memory.dialogue: We both turn to Racheal. Thinking back to the Plaza, I did sense a bit of similar pain when I revived Racheal after she died there.

Memory.speaker: Jasmine
Memory.dialogue: Well, I felt the same, yet noticably less, pain when reviving you

Memory.speaker: Sherlock
Memory.dialogue: If that is the case, I believe that the most easy conclusion to come to is that these two are people working under the Jack Merridew

Memory.speaker: Roger
Memory.dialogue: You, sir, would be correct.

Memory.speaker: Narration
Memory.dialogue: We all turn to find a large group of Beast Hunters standing near us as we once again prepare ourselves

Memory.speaker: Roger
Memory.dialogue: You seem to have interrupted our activities on this island. I had expected our paths to cross again at some point, but I cann ot entertain your childish group right now, Racheal. Men, deal with them. Do not disappoint me.

Memory.speaker: Beast Hunters
Memory.dialogue: SIR YES SIR!

Memory.speaker: Narration
Memory.dialogue: The group of hunters then begin to rush at us as we prepare ourselves for battle

The Violent Child.speaker: Roger
The Violent Child.dialogue: For the love of... *sigh* The rest of you, fall back.

The Violent Child.speaker: Narration
The Violent Child.dialogue: Roger and the rest of the group began to fall back

The Violent Child.speaker: Jasmine
The Violent Child.dialogue: Hey! Were are you... Get back here

The Violent Child.speaker: Narration
The Violent Child.dialogue: We swiftly follow the escaping group of Beast Hunters deep into the mountains as we all approached a more new looking, Divinus Congiont owned Deformality Maintenance Facility

The Violent Child.speaker: Jasmine
The Violent Child.dialogue: Hold on. There are more of these

The Violent Child.speaker: Kyla
The Violent Child.dialogue: There is at least one in every sector, Jasmine.

The Violent Child.speaker: Roger
The Violent Child.dialogue: Well fuck, they followed us. Jack! Have you gotten the door open yet

The Violent Child.speaker: Jack Merridew
The Violent Child.dialogue: No, haven't. I thought I trusted you to take care of the Aero we saw near the base

The Violent Child.speaker: Roger
The Violent Child.dialogue: We killed it... then our little friends team decided to get in the way

The Violent Child.speaker: Narration
The Violent Child.dialogue: Jack stopped feeling around the door before turning to us, looking directly at Racheal,who prepared her spear for combat

The Violent Child.speaker: Jack Merridew
The Violent Child.dialogue: Huh... Well. I was certain I killed you back at the plaza, so I assume the lady in white is responsible for why I'm seeing a ghost infront of me

The Violent Child.speaker: Narration
The Violent Child.dialogue: Jack's eyes slowly moved towards me as I back away.

The Violent Child.speaker: Jack Merridew
The Violent Child.dialogue: Well then it's a good thing you followed. Roger, kill her. Oh, and you can make it as bloody as possible. I know that's your style anyways...

The Violent Child.speaker: Narration
The Violent Child.dialogue: A subtly, maniac like smile began to form as the permission was given.

The Violent Child.speaker: Roger
The Violent Child.dialogue: It will be done, sir. I'll make it as bloody as possibly... CHARGE IN MEN. AFTER THE WOMAN IN WHITE

The Violent Child.speaker: Narration
The Violent Child.dialogue: The remaining soliders charged forth at us as the Elite move to protect me

Deformalities 2.speaker: Narration
Deformalities 2.dialogue: We are able to take out the remaining members of the beast hunters and back Roger into a corner.

Deformalities 2.speaker: Jasmine
Deformalities 2.dialogue: Alright, now that that's dealt with...

Deformalities 2.speaker: Narration
Deformalities 2.dialogue: Suddenly, a thick purple fog emerged from the area of the Deformality Containment Facility. Turning to the area in which it was coming from, I notice that Jack had managed to get the door of the facility open while we were dealing with the other members of his group.

Deformalities 2.speaker: Kyla
Deformalities 2.dialogue: A Spectral zone... inside the facility. It has to have been there for a while now, who knows how powerful the raidrunner has become

Deformalities 2.speaker: Narration
Deformalities 2.dialogue: All the people near the door simply stared at the door in anticipation of something as soft footsteps could be heard from the inside coming out.

Deformalities 2.speaker: Ghost of Simon
Deformalities 2.dialogue: So... you came back...

Deformalities 2.speaker: Narration
Deformalities 2.dialogue: Racheal, Roger and Jack all immediately seemed to remember this ghouls voice, with Jack stepping back from the door of the facility

Deformalities 2.speaker: Jack Merridew
Deformalities 2.dialogue: Simon...

Deformalities 2.speaker: Narration
Deformalities 2.dialogue: he figure fully made his way out of the facility and looked through the entire crowd. Racheal had begun to move towards them but were stopped by Kyla.

Deformalities 2.speaker: Kyla
Deformalities 2.dialogue: Racheal, please stop for a moment. The reason Banquo still retained his goodwill was because of how recent the spectral zone we found him in was opened. There is no guarantee that...

Deformalities 2.speaker: Narration
Deformalities 2.dialogue: Racheal didn't even care to listen, pushing past Kyla and approaching Simon still

Deformalities 2.speaker: Ghost of Simon
Deformalities 2.dialogue: What's the matter? Guilt?

Deformalities 2.speaker: Racheal
Deformalities 2.dialogue: More than that...

Deformalities 2.speaker: Narration
Deformalities 2.dialogue: The Ghoul looked over to the group, then over to the facility before walking back in

Deformalities 2.speaker: Jack Merridew
Deformalities 2.dialogue: W-Wait! Where are you...

Deformalities 2.speaker: Ghost of Simon
Deformalities 2.dialogue: Elite. What you search for is in here. Jack. Although nothing is here on this island for you... you still persist in your belief that...

Deformalities 2.speaker: Jack Merridew
Deformalities 2.dialogue: YOU DON'T UNDERSTAND, DO YOU!?!

Deformalities 2.speaker: Narration
Deformalities 2.dialogue: Jack seemed to raise his voice, causing all other people in the area to stop motion

Deformalities 2.speaker: Jack Merridew
Deformalities 2.dialogue: But I do... I'll kill the beast, and at last you all will be able to pass on peacefully. Everyone who died on that island... it won't matter. Once it's dead they'll finally move on. We'll finally move on...

Deformalities 2.speaker: Jack Merridew
Deformalities 2.dialogue: ...You'll finally move on...

Deformalities 2.speaker: Narration
Deformalities 2.dialogue: Simon seemed to look at Jack with a sense of sympathy and disgust.

Deformalities 2.speaker: Ghost of Simon
Deformalities 2.dialogue: If you truly still believe that a... 'Beast'... lives in this forest, your answers are in here.

Deformalities 2.speaker: Narration
Deformalities 2.dialogue: And with that, the ghoul walked back into the facility.

Deformalities 2.speaker: Narration
Deformalities 2.dialogue: After a bit of shock, Jack ran into the facility, with Roger close on his tail

Deformalities 2.speaker: Jasmine
Deformalities 2.dialogue: That was... odd. They seem mostly helpful.

Deformalities 2.speaker: Kyla
Deformalities 2.dialogue: True, maybe not enough time has passed... we must move quickly then, while the spectral core's energy levels are still unreadable by Divinus

Deformalities 2.speaker: Narration
Deformalities 2.dialogue: I nod in agreement as we quickly go after the duo.

Deformalities 2.speaker: Narration
Deformalities 2.dialogue: The inside of the facility was a cave like structure with the usual Divinus branded walls as were seen in the facility in the F Sector. Noticably, Jack was banging at a closed door ahead of us down the hallway.

Deformalities 2.speaker: Narration
Deformalities 2.dialogue: Suddenly, a containment chamber to the left of us slowly opened up, and sounds from the deformality within it could be heard clearly

Deformalities 2.speaker: Jack Merridew
Deformalities 2.dialogue: That must be it! The Beast! Roger...

Deformalities 2.speaker: George
Deformalities 2.dialogue: It is clear that you and your friend have no experience in the handling of Deformalities.

Deformalities 2.speaker: Roger
Deformalities 2.dialogue: Deformalities?

Deformalities 2.speaker: Narration
Deformalities 2.dialogue: The creature had slowly begun to make it's way out of the containment chamber and rushed at us

Deformalities 2.speaker: Jack Merridew
Deformalities 2.dialogue: Stand your ground, Roger! We're still hunters, after all

Deformalities 2.speaker: Narration
Deformalities 2.dialogue: The duo had begun to engage the deformality as we watched on

Deformalities 2.speaker: Kyla
Deformalities 2.dialogue: Miss Jasmine.

Deformalities 2.speaker: Narration
Deformalities 2.dialogue: Kyla spoke up, looking at the fighting ahead of us

Deformalities 2.speaker: Kyla
Deformalities 2.dialogue: Even though they are at odds against us, it is inperative that we destroy the core in as much time as possible. So, it would be wise for us to assist them...

Deformalities 2.speaker: Jasmine
Deformalities 2.dialogue: Alright... Guys, let's move.

On the Island 1.speaker: Narration
On the Island 1.dialogue: With our combined strengths, we're able to take down the deformality with ease

On the Island 1.speaker: Joel
On the Island 1.dialogue: Alright, that's dealt with. Let's hurry up and get out of...

On the Island 1.speaker: Narration
On the Island 1.dialogue: As Joel approach the door further into the facility, the door at the entrance slammed shut, leaving us all in complete darkness

On the Island 1.speaker: Joel
On the Island 1.dialogue: ...here

On the Island 1.speaker: Narration
On the Island 1.dialogue: A purple fog emerged from the center of the room

On the Island 1.speaker: Macduff
On the Island 1.dialogue: Another one has appeared... and why... does... it make me feel...

On the Island 1.speaker: Macduff
On the Island 1.dialogue: ...So...tired...

On the Island 1.speaker: Narration
On the Island 1.dialogue: Suddenly, Macduff collapsed to the ground, followed by a couple more of the Elite

On the Island 1.speaker: Jasmine
On the Island 1.dialogue: WHAT THE...

On the Island 1.speaker: Narration
On the Island 1.dialogue: Suddenly, my body felt weak as everyone collapsed around me, the smoke had made it's way over to me as well

On the Island 1.speaker: Jasmine
On the Island 1.dialogue: God... damnit... we don't have time... for... this...

On the Island 1.speaker: Narration
On the Island 1.dialogue: Eventually, I fell to the ground as well, being knocked out by whatever the fog was

On the Island 1.speaker: Context
On the Island 1.dialogue: A Spectral Memory

On the Island 1.speaker: Context Narration
On the Island 1.dialogue: The sound of bushes rustling could be heard as a young girl lowered herself down to a lagoon near a beach after a commercial plane they had stayed in just crashed. They were cold, shaken, and somewhat fearful until suddenly, they heard a voice

On the Island 1.speaker: Unknown Male Kid
On the Island 1.dialogue: Hi. Hold on a minute.

On the Island 1.speaker: Context Narration
On the Island 1.dialogue: The boy made his way out of the undergrowth nearby and approached the girl in a calm man

On the Island 1.speaker: Unknown Male Kid
On the Island 1.dialogue: Where's the man with the megaphone?

On the Island 1.speaker: Young Girl
On the Island 1.dialogue: This is an island... At least I think it's an island. That's a reef out in the sea. Perhaps there aren't any grownups anywhere.

On the Island 1.speaker: Unknown Male Kid
On the Island 1.dialogue: All the kids... some must have got out, They had to have, didn't thay?

On the Island 1.speaker: Context Narration
On the Island 1.dialogue: The girl, seeming uninterested, began to walk towards the water as casually as possible as the Male Kid followed behind her

On the Island 1.speaker: Unknown Male Kid
On the Island 1.dialogue: Are there really no grownups here?

On the Island 1.speaker: Young Girl
On the Island 1.dialogue: I don't think so... I  think we were attacked. Half the cabin was dragged out into sea. There must have been a couple of kids in it when it got pull away

On the Island 1.speaker: Unknown Male Kid
On the Island 1.dialogue: What's your name?

On the Island 1.speaker: Context Narration
On the Island 1.dialogue: The girl halted for a bit, turned to the male, then decided to answer his question

On the Island 1.speaker: Young Racheal
On the Island 1.dialogue: Racheal. My name's Racheal.

On the Island 1.speaker: Context Narration
On the Island 1.dialogue: THe boy expected her to ask for his name, but after he didn't get the question, he continued on his own

On the Island 1.speaker: Unknown Male Kid
On the Island 1.dialogue: My name is... well, they used to call me 'Piggy' before in school, but...

On the Island 1.speaker: Context Narration
On the Island 1.dialogue: Upon hearing the name 'Piggy', the young Racheal bursted out into an uncontrollable fit of laughter as 'Piggy', embarrased, tried to comfirm her of his real name, to no avail.

On the Island 1.speaker: Context
On the Island 1.dialogue: The enviroment shifts in a purple haze, the vision now showing a young Racheal blowing into a conch shell, young children approaching the place they were and Piggy getting the name of the children approaching

On the Island 1.speaker: Context Narration
On the Island 1.dialogue: After a while of blowing the conch shell, Racheal ceased, and the echo died down as a group of darkly clothed individuals approached the group of children and teenagers

On the Island 1.speaker: Context Narration
On the Island 1.dialogue: Infront of all of them, was a teenage boy who seemed to lead them through the forests. Theyall wore the same uniforms, and were all sweaty from the effort and the suns fierce light

On the Island 1.speaker: Unknown Choir Lead
On the Island 1.dialogue: Who's the man with the trumpet?

On the Island 1.speaker: Young Racheal
On the Island 1.dialogue: There's no man with a trumpet. Only me.

On the Island 1.speaker: Unknown Choir Lead
On the Island 1.dialogue: Isn't there a ship, then?, Isn't there a man here?

On the Island 1.speaker: Young Racheal
On the Island 1.dialogue: No. We're having a meeting. Come and join in.

On the Island 1.speaker: Context Narration
On the Island 1.dialogue: While the lead stood silently, the exhausted group of boys had begun to scatter from their close line.

On the Island 1.speaker: Unknown Choir Lead
On the Island 1.dialogue: Choir! Stand still!

On the Island 1.speaker: Context Narration
On the Island 1.dialogue: In an obedient fashion, while pleading with the choir lead to let them rest, the group of boys huddled back into line

On the Island 1.speaker: Context Narration
On the Island 1.dialogue: Suddenly, however, one of the boys ended up falling on his face to the ground, and the line broke.

On the Island 1.speaker: Unknown Choir Lead
On the Island 1.dialogue: Alright then. Sit down. Let him alone.

On the Island 1.speaker: Huddle of Choir Boys
On the Island 1.dialogue: ...But Merridew

On the Island 1.speaker: Young Jack
On the Island 1.dialogue: He's always throwing a faint. He did in the plaza.; and at the port; and at the airport... whatever. You, the one with the shell in hand, aren't there any grownups?

On the Island 1.speaker: Young Racheal
On the Island 1.dialogue: No.

On the Island 1.speaker: Context
On the Island 1.dialogue: The enviroment shifts once more to a circle of young children and teenagers with their hands raised, and Racheal counting the hands

On the Island 1.speaker: Young Racheal
On the Island 1.dialogue: I'm Cheif then. Well, Jack can still have leadership of the Choir.

On the Island 1.speaker: Huddle of Choir Boys
On the Island 1.dialogue: We could be the army, or the hunters.

On the Island 1.speaker: Young Racheal
On the Island 1.dialogue: So Jack...

On the Island 1.speaker: Context Narration
On the Island 1.dialogue: Racheal looked towards Jack, as the choir boys mentioned amongst themselves what their job could be performing on the island

On the Island 1.speaker: Young Racheal
On the Island 1.dialogue: What do you want the choir to be...

On the Island 1.speaker: Context Narration
On the Island 1.dialogue: Jack did seem to put any thought into the answer, as if he knew the answer already

On the Island 1.speaker: Young Jack
On the Island 1.dialogue: We'll be the hunters.

On the Island 1.speaker: Context
On the Island 1.dialogue: The group re-awaken.

On the Island 1.speaker: Narration
On the Island 1.dialogue: I wake up immediately in a confused motion.

On the Island 1.speaker: Jasmine
On the Island 1.dialogue: HEY! Is anyone okay?

On the Island 1.speaker: Kyla
On the Island 1.dialogue: We are alright, Miss Jasmine. We may have seen a vision manufactured by the Ghoul

On the Island 1.speaker: Ghost of Simon
On the Island 1.dialogue: They are memories, not manufactured. And they are her's

On the Island 1.speaker: Narration
On the Island 1.dialogue: Simon had re-appeared again, his hand pointed past me and directly at Racheal, who was starting to look shakey and scared

On the Island 1.speaker: Jack Merridew
On the Island 1.dialogue: What's the point of this, Simon. Replaying our memories on here to these people. What's your goal here?

On the Island 1.speaker: Ghost of Simon
On the Island 1.dialogue: For you to learn... You three still believe, to some extent, that there is a monster on this island. A 'Beast'. So, I'll remind you of the truth

On the Island 1.speaker: Narration
On the Island 1.dialogue: Simon then walked into the next hallway, the door flying open as I turn towards Racheal once he's left

On the Island 1.speaker: Jasmine
On the Island 1.dialogue: Uhh... Racheal? Are you alright?

On the Island 1.speaker: Narration
On the Island 1.dialogue: Racheal looked up once I mentioned her name, before slowly regaining her composure and responding

On the Island 1.speaker: Racheal
On the Island 1.dialogue: I-I'm fine. Let's just go. We don't have much time, do we.

On the Island 1.speaker: Narration
On the Island 1.dialogue: Despite my own thoughts of the latter, I accepted her answer, and we proceeded into the next room

On the Island 1.speaker: Narration
On the Island 1.dialogue: The next hallway had two containment chambers opposite eachother as Simon, who was waiting in the hallway, turned around and walked through the door at the end of the hallway as both containment chambers swung open

On the Island 1.speaker: Jack Merridew
On the Island 1.dialogue: Ohhh, okay. So this is what we're doing, huh? Roger!

On the Island 1.speaker: Narration
On the Island 1.dialogue: The deformality in the left one was the first to exit, as we and the duo prepared to fight.

On the Island 2.speaker: Narration
On the Island 2.dialogue: We are able to take out the two deformalities as a purple fog fills the room again

On the Island 2.speaker: Jasmine
On the Island 2.dialogue: We have no time for this... We've gotta get rid of that Spectral Core soon. So, Monster! break the wall down!!!

On the Island 2.speaker: Narration
On the Island 2.dialogue: My commans fall upon deaf ears as The Monster, along with everyone else, were already knocked out

On the Island 2.speaker: Ghost of Simon
On the Island 2.dialogue: Worry not about time, young soul. No time passes outside of Racheal, Jack, Roger and I's memories of the island. It would be like... blinking.

On the Island 2.speaker: Jasmine
On the Island 2.dialogue: Yeah... but...

On the Island 2.speaker: Narration
On the Island 2.dialogue: Due to lacking the energy to argue back, I am forced to accept his logic as I pass out as well.

On the Island 2.speaker: Context
On the Island 2.dialogue: A Spectral Memory

On the Island 2.speaker: Context Narration
On the Island 2.dialogue: A huge round circle of kids could be seen, eating scraps from a pig that they had roasted over a small fire

On the Island 2.speaker: Context Narration
On the Island 2.dialogue: Piggy was more kept to himself while he ate, and Simon had a piece of meat next to him that he hadn't touched. Jack was glaring directly at him for a bit. It would seem that they had just had a heavily charged conversation

On the Island 2.speaker: Present Child
On the Island 2.dialogue: Where did you find the pig?

On the Island 2.speaker: Context Narration
On the Island 2.dialogue: One of the children finally broke the silence with a simple question. Roger had quickly answered while pointing in a direction.

On the Island 2.speaker: Young Roger
On the Island 2.dialogue: They were there. By the sea-

On the Island 2.speaker: Young Jack
On the Island 2.dialogue: TO BE EXACT, we spread round. I crept, on hands and knees. The spears fell out because they hadn't barbs on. It ran away, mad an awful noise to

On the Island 2.speaker: Context Narration
On the Island 2.dialogue: All the choir boys broke into an unorganised jumble of voices as Racheal, who looked on at the group, silently ate some of the meat Jack got, envious and resentful.

On the Island 2.speaker: Context
On the Island 2.dialogue: A shift in location to a group of kids in an assembly

On the Island 2.speaker: Young Racheal
On the Island 2.dialogue: We need an assembly. Not for fun. Not for laughing and falling off the log, or for making jokes, or for... for cleverness. Not for these things.

On the Island 2.speaker: Context Narration
On the Island 2.dialogue: Racheal paused for a bit before continuing

On the Island 2.speaker: Young Racheal
On the Island 2.dialogue: We'll have lots of these serious assemblies. We mostly sleep in shelters. Tonight, you'll all sleep there. Who built all three of those shelters? We all built the first one, four of us built the second, but me and simon did the last one. That's why it's so tottery

On the Island 2.speaker: Young Racheal
On the Island 2.dialogue: And another thing. We chose those rocks right along beyond the bathing pool as a... lavatory. That was sensible too. THe tide cleans the place up. Now people seem to use anywhere. Even near the shelters and the platform...

On the Island 2.speaker: Context Narration
On the Island 2.dialogue: Suddenly, the group of listening younger children bursted out into laughter as Racheal let out a sigh of dissapointment, noticed Piggy's out-stretched had, and handed him the conch

On the Island 2.speaker: Piggy
On the Island 2.dialogue: We've all got to use the rocks again. This place is getting dirty. And then: about the fire...

On the Island 2.speaker: Young Racheal
On the Island 2.dialogue: Ahh, the fire. Piggy?

On the Island 2.speaker: Context Narration
On the Island 2.dialogue: Piggy handed Racheal the conch as she let out a little gasp before speaking up

On the Island 2.speaker: Young Racheal
On the Island 2.dialogue: The fire is the most important thing on the island. How can we ever be rescued by luck, if we don't keep a fire going? Is a fire too mcuh for us to make? Look at us! How many are we? And yet we can't keep a fire going to make smoke. Don't you understand? Can't you see we ought to_ought to die before we let the fire out?

On the Island 2.speaker: Young Racheal
On the Island 2.dialogue: We've got to make smoke up there-or die.

On the Island 2.speaker: Context Narration
On the Island 2.dialogue: Other than a couple giggles and snikers that Racheal was swift to condemn, the room had fallen silent for a bit.

On the Island 2.speaker: Young Racheal
On the Island 2.dialogue: Now! Does anyone else have something to say. I was gonna talk about the talk from the littleuns'... but I don't think...

On the Island 2.speaker: Young Jack
On the Island 2.dialogue: Well, if I may, Miss Cheif.

On the Island 2.speaker: Context Narration
On the Island 2.dialogue: Racheal handed Jack the conch as he immediately started speaking after he got it.

On the Island 2.speaker: Young Jack
On the Island 2.dialogue: This is a meeting to find out what's what. I'll tell you what's what. You littleuns started all this, with the fear talk. Beasts! Where from? Of course we're frightened sometimes but we put up with it. Only Racheal says you scream in the night. What does that mean but nightmares? Anyways, you don't hunt or build or help-you're a lot of cry-babies and sissies. That's what. You'll just have to put up with that fear like the rest of us.

On the Island 2.speaker: Context Narration
On the Island 2.dialogue: Racheal simple sat there, shocked at what Jack had just said. Jack, however, continued

On the Island 2.speaker: Young Jack
On the Island 2.dialogue: The thing is, fear can't hurt you any more than a dream. There aren't any beasts to be afraid of on this island... Serve you right if something did get you, you useless lot of cry-babies.

On the Island 2.speaker: Context
On the Island 2.dialogue: A sudden shift in location, Jack and most of the choir are puting the head of a boar on a sharp stake

On the Island 2.speaker: Young Jack
On the Island 2.dialogue: It's head for the beast... It's a gift...

On the Island 2.speaker: Context
On the Island 2.dialogue: Another sudden shift in location. The kids on the island are grouped around a fire...

On the Island 2.speaker: Young Racheal
On the Island 2.dialogue: I'M CHEIF, because you chose me. And we were going to keep the fire going. Now you run after food...

On the Island 2.speaker: Young Jack
On the Island 2.dialogue: You ran yourself! Look at that bone in your hands!

On the Island 2.speaker: Young Racheal
On the Island 2.dialogue: I-I said were hunters. That was your-

On the Island 2.speaker: Young Jack
On the Island 2.dialogue: Who'll join my tribe and have fun?

On the Island 2.speaker: Context Narration
On the Island 2.dialogue: A voice could be heard at a low whisper. It sounded like Racheal's, although the Racheal within the memory did not say those words as the vision shifted again

On the Island 2.speaker: Young Jack
On the Island 2.dialogue: Do our dance! Come on! DANCE!

On the Island 2.speaker: Context
On the Island 2.dialogue: The scene then shifted again, a group of children chasing after one child, Simon, in a rowdy chaos of laughes, screams, and song.
STOP!!!

On the Island 2.speaker: Context
On the Island 2.dialogue: The Scene shifts. Simon's dead body moved by the waves into the open sea, before shifting once again to Racheal and Piggy

On the Island 2.speaker: Piggy
On the Island 2.dialogue: You're still cheif! You are. Over us. Stop laughing like that. Look, there ain't no eed, Racheal! What's the others going to think?

On the Island 2.speaker: Context Narration
On the Island 2.dialogue: She was laughing in a ditressed matter, but then stopped laughing after Piggy finished speaking. She was shivering.

On the Island 2.speaker: Young Racheal
On the Island 2.dialogue: Piggy.

On the Island 2.speaker: Piggy
On the Island 2.dialogue: Uh?

On the Island 2.speaker: Young Racheal
On the Island 2.dialogue: That was Simon.

On the Island 2.speaker: Context
On the Island 2.dialogue: The group re-awaken.

On the Island 2.speaker: Narration
On the Island 2.dialogue: I swiftly get up, but I notice that Jack and Racheal had woken up before me

On the Island 2.speaker: Jack Merridew
On the Island 2.dialogue: Aww, what's the matter. Nothing wrong with a little remembrance, so why you getting all teary eyed.
