Onward2.dialogue: Jack, who was determined to win against us, used everything in his power to defeat us and get past. But with a joint effort, We knocked the creature to it's feet

Onward2.speaker: Jack, Lord of the Flies
Onward2.dialogue: ....No... NO NO NOOO NO. This isn't how this ends, I'm not loosing like thi......

Onward2.speaker: Narration
Onward2.dialogue: In a simple motion, Racheal struck her spear through the neck of the defenseless Jack, stopping him from speaking

Onward2.speaker: Racheal
Onward2.dialogue: Be still.

Onward2.speaker: Narration
Onward2.dialogue: Jack's body slowly began to be still as he looked to Racheal, not seeing the girl who had feared him and his consequences, but seeing someone who could finally move on in remembrance of those lost

Onward2.speaker: Jack, Lord of the Flies
Onward2.dialogue: ....I failed... I didn't even kill the Beast either... You finally pulled the courage to strike me down together...

Onward2.speaker: Narration
Onward2.dialogue: Racheal watched silently as Jack looked onwards to her

Onward2.speaker: Jack, Lord of the Flies
Onward2.dialogue: You know... maybe you were right Simon... you were always one of the smarter ones, weren't you... Maybe...

Onward2.speaker: Jack Merridew
Onward2.dialogue: ...Maybe there wasn't... a Beast... in this... island...

Onward2.speaker: Narration
Onward2.dialogue: Jack suddenly shifted back to his normal self, finally accepting the truth shown to him by Simon before silently dying.

Onward2.speaker: Narration
Onward2.dialogue: After comfirming that Jack was dead, Racheal removed the spear from his neck and walked to Simon, who smiled. She picked up the Spectral Core that Joel dropped when entering the fight and stared at it solemnly

Onward2.speaker: Ghost of Simon
Onward2.dialogue: Thank you... Racheal...

Onward2.speaker: Racheal
Onward2.dialogue: I'm sorry.

Onward2.speaker: Narration
Onward2.dialogue: Racheal looked at Simon, apologising to them in a low voice, her eyes beginning to well up with tears

Onward2.speaker: Ghost of Simon
Onward2.dialogue: ...I understand. You were young, you weren't yourself then... You weren't the only one responsible for my death.

Onward2.speaker: Racheal
Onward2.dialogue: ...I can make it right, I can bring you back

Onward2.speaker: Ghost of Simon
Onward2.dialogue: Don't. I wish to leave this earth, to move on from the cycle of violence. You could bring Piggy back if you wish to make us of that promise of your's, but I wish to stay dead, if that's okay by you?

Onward2.speaker: Narration
Onward2.dialogue: Racheal, shocked by this statment from Simon, nodded in agreement as the Ghost of Simon dissappeared.

Onward2.speaker: Narration
Onward2.dialogue: Racheal gave me the Spectral Core, and I looked into it. It was the first time I held it in my own hands.

Onward2.speaker: Jasmine
Onward2.dialogue: So, what are we going to do with it.

Onward2.speaker: Kyla
Onward2.dialogue: We don't know, the best we can do is keep it with this one here

Onward2.speaker: Narration
Onward2.dialogue: Kyla pulled out a small capsule, clicked a button it, and it grew to a larger size with the Spectral Core we got from F Sector in the capsule

Onward2.speaker: Narration
Onward2.dialogue: as I moved to give her the Spectral Core, I felt a sudden sharp pain from the hand that held the Spectral Core

Onward2.speaker: Jasmine
Onward2.dialogue: WHAT THE FUCK!?!

Onward2.speaker: Narration
Onward2.dialogue: I looked down to the hand and see the Spectral Core seemingly fusing with my body as the pain increased

Onward2.speaker: Jasmine
Onward2.dialogue: GET IT OF! GET IT OF ME!!!

Onward2.speaker: Narration
Onward2.dialogue: The Monster picked me up by the arm and tried to pull the core out, to no avail

Onward2.speaker: The Monster
Onward2.dialogue: ... I can't...

Onward2.speaker: Jasmine
Onward2.dialogue: WHAT DO YOU MEAN YOU CAN'T!?!

Onward2.speaker: Narration
Onward2.dialogue: Suddenly, my body felt drowsy as the Spectral Core fully fuse with me

Onward2.speaker: Narration
Onward2.dialogue: I was within my own mind, and I could see a figure ahead of me. It was the Ghost of Simon

Onward2.speaker: Ghost of Simon
Onward2.dialogue: ...Well. This is an odd development.

Onward2.speaker: Jasmine
Onward2.dialogue: What are you doing in my head?

Onward2.speaker: Narration
Onward2.dialogue: Simon's ghost simply just shrugged then looked to me.

Onward2.speaker: Ghost of Simon
Onward2.dialogue: While I don't know what is happening as of now, I think that there has to be a purpose that me and you can talk to eachother.

Onward2.speaker: Narration
Onward2.dialogue: Simon looked around seeing a memory that had 12 black tendrils reaching downwards towards what i would assume is the heart ahead of him. It was the same one that caused by sudden bouts of sickness and headaches. Simon slowly walked over to it.

Onward2.speaker: Jasmine
Onward2.dialogue: I wouldn't touch that. That memory seems to cause nothing but trouble for me.

Onward2.speaker: Ghost of Simon
Onward2.dialogue: Something tells me that this memories has the answer to why you can see me here.

Onward2.speaker: Narration
Onward2.dialogue: Simon reached out a hand as one of the tendrils seem to disappear. Then, they seemingly retract their hand.

Onward2.speaker: Ghost of Simon
Onward2.dialogue: ...Whatever that was, I felt a bit weaker after it happened. I believe that it drained my power a decent bit to get rid of that binding.

Onward2.speaker: Narration
Onward2.dialogue: I move over to the area in which Simon was, noticing the lack of one tendril blocking the memory and turning towards Simon, whose hand had begun to fade away

Onward2.speaker: Ghost of Simon
Onward2.dialogue: ...Scratch that. I believe that it drained all of my remaining power. I guess this truly is the end for me.

Onward2.speaker: Narration
Onward2.dialogue: Simon turned towards me with a smile on his face.

Onward2.speaker: Ghost of Simon
Onward2.dialogue: If no one has ever told you this, you are a great leader. I'd even say one of the best

Onward2.speaker: Narration
Onward2.dialogue: Simon became the spectral core after disappearing before bonding with my mind as I felt myself waking up to hear a conversation

Onward2.speaker: Stan
Onward2.dialogue: What do you mean it just fused with her?

Onward2.speaker: Kyla
Onward2.dialogue: We don't know. Her body just absorbed it, and she was knocked out.

Onward2.speaker: Jasmine
Onward2.dialogue: Ohh. Hey Stan.

Onward2.speaker: Narration
Onward2.dialogue: I noticed that we were back on the mainland of W Sector, next to the port we got the ship from. Kyla and Stan both turned to look at me as if they had just seen a dead person rise from their grave, to my confusion

Onward2.speaker: Stan
Onward2.dialogue: Ohh, you're awake. What happened to the spectral core.

Onward2.speaker: Jasmine
Onward2.dialogue: Well...

Onward2.speaker: Narration
Onward2.dialogue: I explain everything that happened in my mind, from the memories to my conversation with Simon.

Onward2.speaker: Stan
Onward2.dialogue: Well that contradicts with our scans. Says here that the energy from the Spectral Core isn't coming off of you at all.

Onward2.speaker: Jasmine
Onward2.dialogue: ...Hey, were's everyone else.

Onward2.speaker: Kyla
Onward2.dialogue: Emilia wanted to go see the museum again. Joel followed, the other said they wanted to do some stuff to, and they all left in every which direction.

Onward2.speaker: Jasmine
Onward2.dialogue: Well glad to know Emilia is alright, but what about the Spectral Core.

Onward2.speaker: Kyla
Onward2.dialogue: Well, even though we plan to get rid of them...

Onward2.speaker: Stan
Onward2.dialogue: We had no way of disposing of them before, but now that you seem to be able to absorb them without leaving a trace of their existence, that just gives you another use.

Onward2.speaker: Jasmine
Onward2.dialogue: So you're gonna use me to get rid of the Spectral Cores.

Onward2.speaker: Stan
Onward2.dialogue: Yes.

Onward2.speaker: Jasmine
Onward2.dialogue: ...sure, I guess...

Onward2.speaker: Narration
Onward2.dialogue: I got up from the place I laid down on, noticing the hand I used to absorb the Spectral Core had a purple mist arounded

Onward2.speaker: Jasmine
Onward2.dialogue: And what's this?

Onward2.speaker: Kyla
Onward2.dialogue: We don't know about that either. It is the same kinda as the one that Simon used to show us memories of the island. Maybe it'll help with absorbing the Cores, until we test it out on the second one, we don't really know.

Onward2.speaker: Narration
Onward2.dialogue: The purple mist seemed to fade once I looked towards the areas in W Sector. Beside the huge plaza, there were several smaller shops and areas to get stuff.

Onward2.speaker: Narration
Onward2.dialogue: I knew we still had a couple more Spectral Cores to find, so I turned to Kyla and Stan.

Onward2.speaker: Stan
Onward2.dialogue: Why you looking at me? I've got a place to be right now. Have fun.

Onward2.speaker: Narration
Onward2.dialogue: And with that, in a blitz of speed, Stan disappeared again

Onward2.speaker: Jasmine
Onward2.dialogue: You know, sometimes i think he just doesn't like us.

Onward2.speaker: Kyla
Onward2.dialogue: A bit off. He's just... REALLY lazy.

Onward2.speaker: Narration
Onward2.dialogue: I let out a deep sigh as to not let this deter my focus as I turn to just Kyla.

Onward2.speaker: Jasmine
Onward2.dialogue: Alright, let's look for the gang.

Branch 2.1 Opening.speaker: Kyla
Branch 2.1 Opening.dialogue: Well, before we leave.

Branch 2.1 Opening.speaker: Narration
Branch 2.1 Opening.dialogue: Kyla pulled out the capsule containing the Spectral Core before then pulling out the Spectral Core we obtained from F Sector.

Branch 2.1 Opening.speaker: Kyla
Branch 2.1 Opening.dialogue: I think you should try absorbing this one. We only, for now, know what happens if these things are active for a days worth of time, which is the energy that we can sense to find them. We don't know if these capsule can fully contain them...

Branch 2.1 Opening.speaker: Jasmine
Branch 2.1 Opening.dialogue: Alright...

Branch 2.1 Opening.speaker: Narration
Branch 2.1 Opening.dialogue: Kyla tosses me the Core, and I grab it with my right hand, the one I used to absorb the other Spectral Core. However, nothing seems to happen

Branch 2.1 Opening.speaker: Jasmine
Branch 2.1 Opening.dialogue: Uhh. I think something is suppose to be happening...

Branch 2.1 Opening.speaker: Kyla
Branch 2.1 Opening.dialogue: Well you gotta figure that out before a spectral zone forms, and I need to go gather the rest of The Elite before they all get... To lost...

Branch 2.1 Opening.speaker: Narration
Branch 2.1 Opening.dialogue: And with that, Kyla turned to leave and find the elite while I stood with the Core in my hand, thinking of the reason I could absorb the last one and not this one
Listen to it.

Branch 2.1 Opening.speaker: Narration
Branch 2.1 Opening.dialogue: I swiftly turn around to try and find the location of the voice, but I don't see anything.

Branch 2.1 Opening.speaker: The Spectral Force
Branch 2.1 Opening.dialogue: Calm your self, master. I am the spectral force, the essence of the Spectral Cores you have and will eventually absorb.

Branch 2.1 Opening.speaker: Narration
Branch 2.1 Opening.dialogue: I calm down and look around, not seeing anyone around me.

Branch 2.1 Opening.speaker: The Spectral Force
Branch 2.1 Opening.dialogue: I do not have a physical form as of now, but I can speak to you. Now, calm your mind and think about your encoutner with the child linked to this core.

Branch 2.1 Opening.speaker: Narration
Branch 2.1 Opening.dialogue: I wonder what he meant by 'child', but then I realise something

Branch 2.1 Opening.speaker: Jasmine
Branch 2.1 Opening.dialogue: You mean Banquo, right? I mean, he wasn't really a kid, but whatever you say, I guess

Branch 2.1 Opening.speaker: Narration
Branch 2.1 Opening.dialogue: I close my eyes and begin to think about our encounter with Banquo as I feel the Core begin to resonate with myself.

Branch 2.1 Opening.speaker: Narration
Branch 2.1 Opening.dialogue: I open my eyes within my mind again to see the memory with 11 black tendrils, and someone else. sitting aside on a rock summoned within my mind was Banquo, who was staring into the distance.

Branch 2.1 Opening.speaker: Jasmine
Branch 2.1 Opening.dialogue: Seems like you've made myself at home

Branch 2.1 Opening.speaker: Ghost of Banquo
Branch 2.1 Opening.dialogue: You... have re-awoken me somehow... Explain...

Branch 2.1 Opening.speaker: Jasmine
Branch 2.1 Opening.dialogue: Well, I'm still geting used to this whole thing. The last one that was here suddenly touched that thing over there and...

Branch 2.1 Opening.speaker: Ghost of Banquo
Branch 2.1 Opening.dialogue: You don't seem to notice yet, do you?

Branch 2.1 Opening.speaker: Narration
Branch 2.1 Opening.dialogue: I was confused, but then I looked to my right and notice a training dummy and an image of Macduff infront of me

Branch 2.1 Opening.speaker: The Spectral Force
Branch 2.1 Opening.dialogue: Ahh, it seems like our friend here has notice my set up. Master, If you have yet to notice, you have gained a new ability from assimilating with the first Child.

Branch 2.1 Opening.speaker: Ghost of Banquo
Branch 2.1 Opening.dialogue: A new ability? What could this be about.

Branch 2.1 Opening.speaker: Narration
Branch 2.1 Opening.dialogue: I look around for any response from the being that spoke just a second ago

Branch 2.1 Opening.speaker: The Spectral Force
Branch 2.1 Opening.dialogue: Assimilation with a raidrunner, as you call them, grants you the base of their ability. From the one who learned the truth you gained the Mist of Truth, and from him...

Branch 2.1 Opening.speaker: Narration
Branch 2.1 Opening.dialogue: The Ghost of Banquo slowly began to fade away removing one of the tendrils from the memory.

Branch 2.1 Opening.speaker: Jasmine
Branch 2.1 Opening.dialogue: HEY, WHAT HAPPENED TO HIM!

Branch 2.1 Opening.speaker: The Spectral Force
Branch 2.1 Opening.dialogue: They have only peacefully passed on. Now, your spectral link has grown, and you have gained the ability Sword of the Forgotten

Branch 2.1 Opening.speaker: The Spectral Force
Branch 2.1 Opening.dialogue: Go ahead and test out these new abilities with that dummy over there, using the image of one of your allies that I created

Branch 2.1 Opening.speaker: Narration
Branch 2.1 Opening.dialogue: The image of Macduff seemed to await my command as I slowly approached them.

The Museum.speaker: The Spectral Force
The Museum.dialogue: It seems like you have gotten use to your new abilities, while you can use them in here on a short cost of spectral energy, until you aquire more of the cores, you will have to wait a long time between uses of your new abilities outside in the real world.

The Museum.speaker: Narration
The Museum.dialogue: I look down towards my palm that I used to absorb the core previously, then I sit down for a bit

The Museum.speaker: Jasmine
The Museum.dialogue: Well, other than these combat purposes, what can I do with these.

The Museum.speaker: The Spectral Force
The Museum.dialogue: You will have to wait for your abilities to develop eventually with time. This is the limits of your abilities as of now.

The Museum.speaker: Narration
The Museum.dialogue: The light in my mind began to grow brighter as I used my hand to block it out.

The Museum.speaker: The Spectral Force
The Museum.dialogue: Well, I must leave you for now. My energy is to weak for prolonged interaction with you, unfortunately. Use these abilities to the fullest master...

The Museum.speaker: Narration
The Museum.dialogue: The light blinds me as I awaken on the shoulders of someone. It was the monster, as the group was making their way into the Museum in which Kyla had said Joel and Emilia went, and the one where we were attacked by the Anti Theft Cyborg.

The Museum.speaker: Jasmine
The Museum.dialogue: ...You can put me down now...

The Museum.speaker: The Monster
The Museum.dialogue: Ahh, you're awake.

The Museum.speaker: Narration
The Museum.dialogue: The monster put me down as I steady myself on my feat and walk into the museum

The Museum.speaker: Kyla
The Museum.dialogue: It seems like you've figured out how to absorb the spectral cores, haven't you?

The Museum.speaker: Jasmine
The Museum.dialogue: Yeah. So, once we get Joel and Emilia from the Plaza, where to next?

The Museum.speaker: Kyla
The Museum.dialogue: Well, as of now, there are no readings of a spectral core in the immediate area of the crater, but we have reason to suspect that it is somewhere in E Sector.

The Museum.speaker: Narration
The Museum.dialogue: Kyla glanced down at her hand before speaking up again.

The Museum.speaker: Kyla
The Museum.dialogue: E Sector is know to be the place where... the Extinguishers are the most active...

The Museum.speaker: Jasmine
The Museum.dialogue: Seems like you and that syndicate have some history, huh?

The Museum.speaker: Kyla
The Museum.dialogue: You could say that. Wait, why is this place so empty?

The Museum.speaker: Narration
The Museum.dialogue: I look away from her for a bit and realise that the place is completely except for the constant flashing noise of a camera. Then footsteps could be heard as Emilia moved towards the exit and noticed us.

The Museum.speaker: Emilia
The Museum.dialogue: OH, MISS JASMINE! Hi! You're finally awake, you slept for the entire boat ride here. Are you alright.

The Museum.speaker: Narration
The Museum.dialogue: I look towards her, still remembering what Joel told me happen when he awakened

The Museum.speaker: Jasmine
The Museum.dialogue: Yeah. Do you remember what happened after the Havenus ship split in half.

The Museum.speaker: Emilia
The Museum.dialogue: Not really, I just fell into the water, passed out, and re-awoke alone in the forest. Then the elite and Joel came with you knocked out along with them

The Museum.speaker: Narration
The Museum.dialogue: So she doesn't remember what happened during her process of alteration. Weird

The Museum.speaker: Romeo
The Museum.dialogue: Sooooo. Where's Joel?

The Museum.speaker: Emilia
The Museum.dialogue: Well we were both here together, but then he said he needed to go somewhere. He seemed a bit in a hurry as well, and he seemed to be holding one of his arms a bit tightly

The Museum.speaker: Kyla
The Museum.dialogue: HE did block an attack from Gabriel, so there is a posibility that he was injured in the scuffle and has gone to the medical area to fix up his wound. If that is the case, we should probably met up with him there.

The Museum.speaker: Narration
The Museum.dialogue: I nod in understandment as I look to the elite.

The Museum.speaker: Jasmine
The Museum.dialogue: Alright guys, we're gonna need to push through the crowds again. You all ready?

The Museum.speaker: Narration
The Museum.dialogue: The elite all nodded and prepared themselves enthusiastically for the battle.

The Museum.speaker: Jasmine
The Museum.dialogue: Alright, let's take care of these shoppers and go find Joel!

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: Narration
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: After a while, we eventually reach the medical bay and see Joel waiting at the door.

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: Joel
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: Where's that nurse already. She immediately opened the door before when we came before.

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: Jasmine
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: Joel! What's up?

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: Narration
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: Joel immediately turned around at the sound of my voice as we walked over to him

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: Jasmine
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: You good. What are you here for? You doing alright?

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: Joel
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: Well... you remember when I took that hit from Gabriel.

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: Narration
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: He removed the glove from the arm he used to block the hit, revealing a deep bandaged wound on the arm

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: Joel
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: It's a rudimentary way to stop it from getting infected, but it hurts like hell right now. I'm here to get it checked, I think a bones cracked somewhere in there from the attack

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: Narration
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: I can't help but think about how durable Joel is, as a single slash from Gabriel was more than enough to atomize some of the elite

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: Jasmine
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: Even a graze from their blade was able to cause that much damage. Guess the High Ranked Supressors are just that powerful, huh.

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: George
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: It is very possible that that wasn't even him at his best. They are likely to hold back against people they see as weaker than themselves. Although, it is quite impressive that he could survive a hit like that to begin with.

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: Narration
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: I turn to George after noticing he had spoken up about my comment on High Ranked Supressors, but then the door to the medical bay slowly creaked open, which caught my and the rest of the groups attention.

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: Joel
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: Finally! Been banging on their door for at least 20 minutes. Alright, lets get this over with and leave.

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: Narration
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: We enter the medical bay, as I recognise the area in which I woke up in on arrival to the plaza after I passed out the first time. However, the place is enpty and oddly quiet, with only an open set of door to the next room that I can only assume the nurse came from once I awoke.

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: Joel
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: HELLO! HELLO! ANYONE HOME?

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: Narration
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: The place stayed silent. The lights in the next room were on, so at least a person had to be here, but no one answered.

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: Jasmine
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: That's... weird. I think we should investigate that room with the lights on.

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: Macduff
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: Halt. There is a chance that whatever is in there is not safe and could pose a risk to you, miss Jasmine. If anything, I would suggest one of us go in first and comfirm that the place is safe, then the rest may go through.

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: Racheal
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: If that's the case, I think I should be the one to go in.

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: Narration
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: Before Racheal spoke up swiftly aafter Macduff, most of the elite didn't seem to want to in there by themselves, but Racheal declared her volunteering of herself so confidently that it took me back a bit.

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: Jasmine
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: Well... I guess that settles it. Good luck, Racheal.

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: Narration
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: Racheal seemed to nod with a smile on her face as she open the door to the hallway and walked through. There was a bit of silence for a while, before a voice could be heard from the hallway

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: Racheal
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: No one's here. You guys can move in now.

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: Narration
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: With Racheal's comfirmation, the rest of the group moved forward into the next room.

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: Narration
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: The first thing I'm hit with on entering the hallway was the bright blinding lights that illuminated the completely white and spotless hallway. I shield my eyes from it for a bit before looking around. There is nothing in the room except for another door down the hallway. The sound of talking could be heard eminating form the door across the hallway

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: Jasmine
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: Seems like they're in there. Alright, let's...

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: Narration
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: The door across the hallway suddenly opened as a group of medical staff in matching bloodied uniform and mask funneled out.

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: Medical Staff 1
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: Ahh. You have arrived.

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: Joel
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: Arrived. What's that suppose to mean?

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: Medical Staff 2
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: So you are here to donate yourself for advacements in the medical field, are you?

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: Joel
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: What... the fuck are you guys even talking about. I'm just here to get an injury patched up. Where's the nurse from before

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: Medical Staff 1
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: She proved to but unfufilling in her methods of gathering suitable test subjects.

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: Jasmine
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: Unfufilling? What those tha...

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: Medical Staff 2
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: We were forced to neutralise her. Our experimentation will not escape this place

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: Narration
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: I, upon hearing their words, understood what had happened to the nurse. Such is life, after all. Nothing we could really do about...

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: Goole
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: Within the clause about Employment within the W Sector Plaza rule book:...

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: Narration
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: Goole had begun to speak, as I turned to face him bewildered.

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: Goole
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: 'The employer of someone cannot kill their employee without valid reason.' It is one of the only clauses against killing that exists in the crater. Failure to comply with this rule will lead to funding being cut from this establishment, although you know that, don't you

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: Medical Staff 1
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: What point are you trying to make here, hat wearing one?

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: Goole
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: You have given our group enough proof to comfirm that you have killed them. What is stopping us from reporting this to the higherups at this Plaza?

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: Medical Staff 1
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: Because you will not be leaving here.

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: Narration
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: I could hear the door we entered here from slam shut behind us as all the Medical staff present pulled out various meat handling weapons.

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: Medical Staff 2
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: Please refrain from fighting back. The pain dulls after a while of hacking.

The Medical Bay..?.speaker: Narration
The Medical Bay..?.dialogue: Two of them move forward and begin to confront the group, so we begin fighting them off as they engage us.

What is that thing!.speaker: Narration
What is that thing!.dialogue: Due to the medical staff lacking in skill in comparison to our group, all but two of them were dead.

What is that thing!.speaker: Medical Staff 1
What is that thing!.dialogue: This is... unfortunate

What is that thing!.speaker: Medical Staff 2
What is that thing!.dialogue: However, we are not done with you yet.

What is that thing!.speaker: Narration
What is that thing!.dialogue: The two remaining staff retreat into the room they came from as we attempt to follow, before a voice could be heard through out

What is that thing!.speaker: Sherlock
What is that thing!.dialogue: It would be unwise to give chase now. We have all we need to leave someone else to handle them for us. Best case scenario is we leave now and let W Sector handle this.

What is that thing!.speaker: Narration
What is that thing!.dialogue: Sherlock said something that did make a bit more sense. As Goole said, we've heard enough for funding to this branch to be cut and they'd have to fend for themselves in this place. It would make the most sense for us to leave

What is that thing!.speaker: Jasmine
What is that thing!.dialogue: Well... yeah. You make a good point. Monster, could you help by punching the door down?

What is that thing!.speaker: The Monster
What is that thing!.dialogue: Already on it...

What is that thing!.speaker: Narration
What is that thing!.dialogue: The Monster threw a punch at the steel door, but it wouldn't budge. He threw another, and the same result was gained

What is that thing!.speaker: The Monster
What is that thing!.dialogue: Well fuck, the doors stuck.

What is that thing!.speaker: Kyla
What is that thing!.dialogue: It's most likely as a result of N Sector's magic. The thing won't move until certain conditions are met...

What is that thing!.speaker: Narration
What is that thing!.dialogue: Suddenly, the two medical staff came out of the room they were in before with a tied up patient and a syringe with them.

What is that thing!.speaker: Medical Staff 1
What is that thing!.dialogue: You and your group think you can stop our scientific evolution...

What is that thing!.speaker: Medical Staff 2
What is that thing!.dialogue: ...Well let's see how you fare against our latest scientific advancement...

What is that thing!.speaker: Narration
What is that thing!.dialogue: They drove the syringe into the back of the patients neck and pressed the liquid inside it into them.

What is that thing!.speaker: Medical Staff 1
What is that thing!.dialogue: ...Unlike you, we have the ability to cause Alteration in people who didn't have any leading symptoms towards the process before...

What is that thing!.speaker: Medical Staff 2
What is that thing!.dialogue: ...Observe!

What is that thing!.speaker: Narration
What is that thing!.dialogue: The Patient, who was in a state of panic prior, seemed to stop moving and slump before his body began to rapidly change. his limbs had grown long and lankier, and lots and lots of blood began to pour out of his eyes, his ears, his fingers, which bursted open, and his body.

What is that thing!.speaker: Medical Staff 1
What is that thing!.dialogue: Huzzah, a success.

What is that thing!.speaker: Narration
What is that thing!.dialogue: THe patient the looked down to his hands then looked around him. All he could see was the blood. The blood of others, and the blood of himself

What is that thing!.speaker: Mass Bleeding Patient
What is that thing!.dialogue: What happened to me... why can't I see anything...

What is that thing!.speaker: Jasmine
What is that thing!.dialogue: Well that's an issue if I've ever seen one

What is that thing!.speaker: Narration
What is that thing!.dialogue: The newly created Alteration began to look throughout the room before locking eyes on Joel's arm that had been cut.

What is that thing!.speaker: Mass Bleeding Patient
What is that thing!.dialogue: Is someone there, I can see a red line of something. If that's... a person! YOU GOTTA HELP ME! IT HURTS! EVERYTHING HURTS!! Unless... YOU DID THIS TO ME!!! WHY!!!

What is that thing!.speaker: Narration
What is that thing!.dialogue: The figure began to move towards our group, flailing it's arms around as we stood our ground and tried to fight it.

We lost one!.speaker: Narration
We lost one!.dialogue: In a disgusting explosion of chucks of flesh everywhere, the entire group was knocked away except for Joel, who seemed to be dragged in by something.

We lost one!.speaker: Emilia
We lost one!.dialogue: JOEL!!!

We lost one!.speaker: Narration
We lost one!.dialogue: The Explosion caused us to crash through the door as we were all laid out in the first room we were in before we entered the hallway. The door then, with the power N Sector's magic, regenerated itself and stood closed to stop us from re-entering

We lost one!.speaker: Narration
We lost one!.dialogue: Emilia was the first to get back up and immediately banged on the door while screaming to the highest her voice could climb to.

We lost one!.speaker: Emilia
We lost one!.dialogue: GIVE HIM BACK!

We lost one!.speaker: Narration
We lost one!.dialogue: I'm able to get up swiftly after that and I watch as her banging on the door becomes swifter and swifter. I notice that she was heavily injured from the explosion, but it didn't seem to stop her even a little bit from screaming

We lost one!.speaker: Narration
We lost one!.dialogue: I remember what happened when Joel awoke, and understand now that if I don't act fast, there may a possibility that geting Joel back won't be the only thing we have to deal with. in a swift motion, I stop her from banging on the door and begin to talk to her

We lost one!.speaker: Jasmine
We lost one!.dialogue: He's alright! Don't worry about it.

We lost one!.speaker: Narration
We lost one!.dialogue: Emilia head turn to me in a swift manner.

We lost one!.speaker: Emilia
We lost one!.dialogue: How do you know he's alright in there. He could be hurt, or worse...

We lost one!.speaker: Narration
We lost one!.dialogue: I could feel the air around me and Emilia get heavier, as if something was close to happening

We lost one!.speaker: Jasmine
We lost one!.dialogue: Joel's pretty strojng. I doubt that he would go down without a fight. How about this, you just calm down, and I'll get Joel back safe, kay?

We lost one!.speaker: Narration
We lost one!.dialogue: Emilia began to calm down as the heaviness in the air I felt decreased

We lost one!.speaker: Emilia
We lost one!.dialogue: You... you promise?

We lost one!.speaker: Jasmine
We lost one!.dialogue: Yeah... I promise...

We lost one!.speaker: Narration
We lost one!.dialogue: The words don't reach her, however, as the girl had passed out from her injuries. I picked her up and laid her down on the couch I was laid down on when I was here as the rest of the elite slowly recover from crashing through the door

We lost one!.speaker: Jasmine
We lost one!.dialogue: So... We're gonna need to get through that door. Anyone got a plan?

We lost one!.speaker: Romeo
We lost one!.dialogue: Well obviously... punching didn't work so, maybe we can get a specialist to dispell whatever spell was put on the door.

We lost one!.speaker: Tia
We lost one!.dialogue: And where exactly are we gonna find someone with those capabilities?

We lost one!.speaker: Antonia
We lost one!.dialogue: I mean... I saw a magician who ran shows making use of N Sector Tomes on our way to this medical bay. Maybe they're skilled enough to...

We lost one!.speaker: Narration
We lost one!.dialogue: Suddenly, a loud crash could be heard as a group od shopers barged into the medical bay

We lost one!.speaker: Jasmine
We lost one!.dialogue: What in the... WHY ARE THEY HERE!

We lost one!.speaker: Narration
We lost one!.dialogue: They seemed to just take stuff in the medical bay without care that it was technically stealing before turning to us

We lost one!.speaker: Goole
We lost one!.dialogue: Now that that door is closed, the lights are off in this medical bay. That means the shop is closed. Under the rule: 'All items within a shop become free use to take unit a W Sector Supressor arrives', they can take whatever they want from this place. By the looks of it, the are now eyeing up our weapons

We lost one!.speaker: Romeo
We lost one!.dialogue: They're sick in the head if they think I'd let them just take this rapier.

We lost one!.speaker: Narration
We lost one!.dialogue: The shoppers don't even seem to be listening to us as they slowly approach to try and take our stuff.

We lost one!.speaker: Jasmine
We lost one!.dialogue: *annoyed sigh* well, guess we gotta deal with these guys now.

We lost one!.speaker: Narration
We lost one!.dialogue: The shoppers full on rush at us now as we make use of our weapons to defend ourselves

The Supressor.speaker: Narration
The Supressor.dialogue: We continually fight the near infinite wave of shoppers that all seem to want the weapons we have

The Supressor.speaker: Linda
The Supressor.dialogue: There's no end to these guys. It's like the whole damn plaza is funneling in here everytime we knock on of them out.

The Supressor.speaker: Narration
The Supressor.dialogue: Suddenly, the wave stopped as a path was made for a singular person to enter the medical area in which we were at. The remaining concious shoppers skittered away at the sight of him. He was a man with authority and status, wore a special type of armour with Blue markings on it, and had a W Secotr badge on the back of his hand. Sheathed behind him was a weird looking Longsword that seemed to glow Red and Blue.

The Supressor.speaker: W Sector Class 4 Supressor
The Supressor.dialogue: Alright, first day on the job. Now that I'm here, I just need to check the guidebook. let's see here...

The Supressor.speaker: Narration
The Supressor.dialogue: he looked at us, the back down at the book, then closed the book and looked to us

The Supressor.speaker: W Sector Class 4 Supressor
The Supressor.dialogue: You there. The group of 14. You've been found in a shop after closing hours. No matter what explanation you may have for the reasoning, I am forced to believe you are here to steal from this shop... that's how it goes in the guidebook, I guess...

The Supressor.speaker: Narration
The Supressor.dialogue: They walked over to me and began to stare at me

The Supressor.speaker: W Sector Class 4 Supressor
The Supressor.dialogue: However, your transgressions will be ignored if you are able to pay a very acceptable 1,000,000,000 cash payment-

The Supressor.speaker: Narration
The Supressor.dialogue: The W Sector supressor, along with a good amount of the elite, stood shocked a bit from the instant answer, but the supressor simply continued.

The Supressor.speaker: W Sector Class 4 Supressor
The Supressor.dialogue: Well I guess that makes what has to come next easier. Stand down and prepare to be evicted from this property

The Supressor.speaker: Narration
The Supressor.dialogue: The Supressor drew their longsword and rushed at us as we, once again, were forced to prepare for battle

An Outbreak.speaker: W Sector Class 4 Supressor
An Outbreak.dialogue: Grahh!!

An Outbreak.speaker: Narration
An Outbreak.dialogue: We were able to subdue the Supressor as I got a swift idea.

An Outbreak.speaker: Jasmine
An Outbreak.dialogue: Hey! We aren't here to steal, or to hurt you. We're just here to get through that door

An Outbreak.speaker: Narration
An Outbreak.dialogue: The supressor slowly got up, however, instead of fighting back, since they now knew that we had the power to beat him down, he decided to listen to us

An Outbreak.speaker: W Sector Class 4 Supressor
An Outbreak.dialogue: You know, I'm not allowed to listen to you or else I'd get in a lot of trouble... Oh what the hell. You can continue

An Outbreak.speaker: Narration
An Outbreak.dialogue: Now that they are in the mood to listen, We were, in a disorderly fashion, able to explain everything that happened in the next room over

An Outbreak.speaker: W Sector Class 4 Supressor
An Outbreak.dialogue: Alright, let's see here in the guidebook. 'Elimination of one's employees and Unauthorised Experiments are strictly prohibited'. Well, seems like you are right about that.

An Outbreak.speaker: Narration
An Outbreak.dialogue: They then walked over to the door and raised their sword.

An Outbreak.speaker: W Sector Class 4 Supressor
An Outbreak.dialogue: Well good on me for listening. Our swords are enchanted with several N Sector Tome Spells, including the ability to dispell stuff like this. One swing from this bad boy and that door will swing right open-

An Outbreak.speaker: Narration
An Outbreak.dialogue: The Supressor swung at the door, and as it flew open, a seemingly endless wave of blood poured through.

An Outbreak.speaker: W Sector Class 4 Supressor
An Outbreak.dialogue: What the fu...

An Outbreak.speaker: Narration
An Outbreak.dialogue: The sound of something being dragged away could be heard as the supressor disappeared. The wave eventually pertered out as we were pushed further out of the shop to the group of still shoppers

An Outbreak.speaker: Narration
An Outbreak.dialogue: We were able to push back into the shop as we saw several moving chunks of flesh slide across the floor. Some seemed to try and reach Emilia on were she was, but thet seemed to only be able to move on blood, and there was no blood near her. There was, however, blood all over us and some of the shoppers

An Outbreak.speaker: Bloodlings
An Outbreak.dialogue: Let me be... me...

An Outbreak.speaker: Narration
An Outbreak.dialogue: One seemed to swiftly move towards a shopper before it made contact with them, which caused them to be knocked out but then wake up again with blood shot eyes

An Outbreak.speaker: Narration
An Outbreak.dialogue: THe changed shopper the bit into the hands on another shopper, causing them to have blood shot eyes as well as some of the shoppers attempted to retreat. Soon, there was a ton of shoppers all looking for people to bite and what I can only assume infect.

An Outbreak.speaker: Kyla
An Outbreak.dialogue: The door is open. This isn't our problem. We can just get Joel from in there and...

An Outbreak.speaker: Narration
An Outbreak.dialogue: A couple of Bloodlings blocked our way, and a lot of the shoppers had now started to turn to us as we were surrounded on both sides.

An Outbreak.speaker: Jasmine
An Outbreak.dialogue: Everyone, don't let them touch you.

An Outbreak.speaker: Narration
An Outbreak.dialogue: The bloodlings rushed in first as we prepared ourselves once again

The Heartbroken Cupid.speaker: Narration
The Heartbroken Cupid.dialogue: Hit by hit, we strike away the approaching creatures but with everyone that we take down, another two takes it's place. It's an overwhelming cycle of avoiding getting hit by the creatures and killing them in return

The Heartbroken Cupid.speaker: Narration
The Heartbroken Cupid.dialogue: Macduff doesn't seem to be struggling, I notice, seemingly having experience in fighting large group of people.

The Heartbroken Cupid.speaker: Jasmine
The Heartbroken Cupid.dialogue: Alright, we can't keep this up. We need to find a way to...

The Heartbroken Cupid.speaker: Narration
The Heartbroken Cupid.dialogue: I felt something pull at my leg as I was pulled to the ground by a infected shopper. They were about to bite at an arm I was using to push them away as I just closed my eyes and accepted my fate.

The Heartbroken Cupid.speaker: Narration
The Heartbroken Cupid.dialogue: I opened my eyes again after realising that it had stopped moving. Through it's head was a burning arrow that pretty mcuh instantly killed it, an arrow that then flew out of the infecteds head and over to a woman with red skin, two flaming wings, and a suit with pink higlights. they had a red flaming bow in their hands and several Arrows were flying around them

The Heartbroken Cupid.speaker: Narration
The Heartbroken Cupid.dialogue: They rose one of their hands, and all the arrows flew through the crowd, killing the Bloodling creatures before flying back to her side.

The Heartbroken Cupid.speaker: Afine
The Heartbroken Cupid.dialogue: You people of Havenus. You must be behind this, aren't you?

The Heartbroken Cupid.speaker: Narration
The Heartbroken Cupid.dialogue: I swiftly get back onto my feet and dust myself off before trying to speak

The Heartbroken Cupid.speaker: Jasmine
The Heartbroken Cupid.dialogue: ...Well...

The Heartbroken Cupid.speaker: Narration
The Heartbroken Cupid.dialogue: Suddenly, a loud buzzing noise could be heard as the woman begrudgingly pulled out a phone and answeres the call

The Heartbroken Cupid.speaker: Lenuff
The Heartbroken Cupid.dialogue: Afine. How's it been. You got that thing Divinus wanted?

The Heartbroken Cupid.speaker: Afine
The Heartbroken Cupid.dialogue: The spectral core? Well, I've found the elite squad for Havenus, but not the core yet.

The Heartbroken Cupid.speaker: Lenuff
The Heartbroken Cupid.dialogue: Alright. Just make sure you destroy it once you get it from there. We can't have people seeing ghosts, can we.

The Heartbroken Cupid.speaker: Narration
The Heartbroken Cupid.dialogue: Before she could answer, the call was cut on the other side as she stuffed the phone back in her pocket and looked over to us.

The Heartbroken Cupid.speaker: Afine
The Heartbroken Cupid.dialogue: Well, now that you know what I'm here for, I'll only ask this once...

The Heartbroken Cupid.speaker: Narration
The Heartbroken Cupid.dialogue: Several arrows began to fly around her, preped to shoot right at us

The Heartbroken Cupid.speaker: Afine
The Heartbroken Cupid.dialogue: ...Where's the core?

The Heartbroken Cupid.speaker: Narration
The Heartbroken Cupid.dialogue: I looked towards Kyla, who looked towards me with a looked that seemed to tell be 'wait a moment'. I initially planned to tell her about my ability to absorb the cores, but after looking at Kyla, I held of on that for a bit

The Heartbroken Cupid.speaker: Kyla
The Heartbroken Cupid.dialogue: And they truly plan to destroy the core?

The Heartbroken Cupid.speaker: Narration
The Heartbroken Cupid.dialogue: An arrow shot through the chest of Kyla as the rest of the group stood on guard

The Heartbroken Cupid.speaker: Afine
The Heartbroken Cupid.dialogue: You're dodging the question. What reason does someone like... him have to lie to...

The Heartbroken Cupid.speaker: Narration
The Heartbroken Cupid.dialogue: Macduff began to approach her, sword preped

The Heartbroken Cupid.speaker: Macduff
The Heartbroken Cupid.dialogue: What are you refering to when you say 'someone like... him'

The Heartbroken Cupid.speaker: Narration
The Heartbroken Cupid.dialogue: An arrow flew toward Macduff, and he deflected it, but then it flew back and shot at him through the chest. Then both the one that went through Kyla nd Macduff came back to Afine's sides. I used the world key to heal their wounds and feel the pain of something burnig through my entire body.

The Heartbroken Cupid.speaker: Afine
The Heartbroken Cupid.dialogue: Since you won't be of much use to me... I will be forced to dispose of you, then investigate this phenomina and the spectral cores as well

The Heartbroken Cupid.speaker: Narration
The Heartbroken Cupid.dialogue: Arrows then flew directly at us as the elite rushed in to fight her

To The Hallway Again.speaker: Narration
To The Hallway Again.dialogue: After a bit of fighting, Afine backed away, exhausted

To The Hallway Again.speaker: Afine
To The Hallway Again.dialogue: Well... It's understandable now why does two could handle you in combat... You are quite the annoyance of a group...

To The Hallway Again.speaker: Narration
To The Hallway Again.dialogue: She straightened her posture and recalled her arrows, which all flew around her before disappearing into her wings

To The Hallway Again.speaker: Antonia
To The Hallway Again.dialogue: Two wings, huh. You were part of the guard?

To The Hallway Again.speaker: Narration
To The Hallway Again.dialogue: Antonia decided to strike up conversation with her, to her confusion

To The Hallway Again.speaker: Afine
To The Hallway Again.dialogue: Why are you suddenly so talkative?

To The Hallway Again.speaker: Antonia
To The Hallway Again.dialogue: Well because it seems to me...

To The Hallway Again.speaker: Narration
To The Hallway Again.dialogue: Antonia turned to Kyla, who seemed to nod at her

To The Hallway Again.speaker: Antonia
To The Hallway Again.dialogue: ...both our groups have similar goals. We're also looking to get rid of the spectral cores

To The Hallway Again.speaker: Narration
To The Hallway Again.dialogue: Afine seems to look away in thought for a bit as Antonia speaked up

To The Hallway Again.speaker: Antonia
To The Hallway Again.dialogue: Also. I gotta ask. In my time in H Sector, i've seen quite a lot of pink and blue cupids, but seems like you're a red one. Doesn't seem natural.

To The Hallway Again.speaker: Narration
To The Hallway Again.dialogue: Afine stood in deep thought still before turning to antonia and speaking up.

To The Hallway Again.speaker: Afine
To The Hallway Again.dialogue: It was a specific night. Me and a couple friends, including a particularly close one, were just celebrating an event when someone knocked at the door

To The Hallway Again.speaker: Narration
To The Hallway Again.dialogue: Antonia's expression immediately changed to one of worry

To The Hallway Again.speaker: Afine
To The Hallway Again.dialogue: They had a mask on, and once one of my friends open the door... It... It was a massacre. They started killing everyone there, until my friend, he helped me hide from the figure. That... that was the last time I saw him alive...

To The Hallway Again.speaker: Antonia
To The Hallway Again.dialogue: N-Nevermind. Thanks for the explaination... That's... that's really...

To The Hallway Again.speaker: Narration
To The Hallway Again.dialogue: In a frantic and cautious manner, Antonia backed off, seemingly heldback from saying something. I turn to her only to notice her looking down at her sheild in a worried manner

To The Hallway Again.speaker: Kyla
To The Hallway Again.dialogue: What my friend here was trying to say was that we could work together to deal with this case of infection. Speaking of which...

To The Hallway Again.speaker: Narration
To The Hallway Again.dialogue: After hearing a couple of noises, Afine moved away from the door to see a ton of infected shoppers, and some Bloodlings began to make their way out of the hallway again

To The Hallway Again.speaker: Afine
To The Hallway Again.dialogue: The creatures are back again... Fine. I'll help you out with this and report that the core has already been destroyed. This is obviously of higher importance at the moment

To The Hallway Again.speaker: Infected Shoppers
To The Hallway Again.dialogue: ...Don't... hurt them...

To The Hallway Again.speaker: Narration
To The Hallway Again.dialogue: The shoppers somehow began to speak in understandable language instead of the usual groans and biting

To The Hallway Again.speaker: Infected Shoppers
To The Hallway Again.dialogue: I... need them... I want to... be... again...

To The Hallway Again.speaker: Afine
To The Hallway Again.dialogue: What do you mean by that?

To The Hallway Again.speaker: Narration
To The Hallway Again.dialogue: The shoppers eyes went from blood shot to straight up red as they continued to speak

To The Hallway Again.speaker: Infected Shoppers
To The Hallway Again.dialogue: I don't... want to be... this... I want to... be me... I need you... all to... be me... again...

To The Hallway Again.speaker: Narration
To The Hallway Again.dialogue: And with that, the shoppers dashed towrds us as we once again prepared to fight them again

The Heart of the Mass Bleeding Patient.speaker: Narration
The Heart of the Mass Bleeding Patient.dialogue: Pushing past the Bloodlings stoping us from moving forth into the hallway and after killing the infected shoppers with the help of Afine, we're able to make our way into the hallway that the patient was transformed in.

The Heart of the Mass Bleeding Patient.speaker: Narration
The Heart of the Mass Bleeding Patient.dialogue: The hallway looked way different. The bright white lights now replaced with walls, floor, and ceiling completely stained red with blood. at the end of the hallway, where the Patient was, laid an egg shaped flesh mound that pulsated slowly. Joel stood there, looking directly at it.

The Heart of the Mass Bleeding Patient.speaker: Narration
The Heart of the Mass Bleeding Patient.dialogue: Afine seemed to pull her phone out again, but instead called someone else upon seeing the core

The Heart of the Mass Bleeding Patient.speaker: Victor
The Heart of the Mass Bleeding Patient.dialogue: Yes.

The Heart of the Mass Bleeding Patient.speaker: Narration
The Heart of the Mass Bleeding Patient.dialogue: The monster seemed to turn their head directly towards her with her notice him staring at the phone while continuing to talk to the figure

The Heart of the Mass Bleeding Patient.speaker: Afine
The Heart of the Mass Bleeding Patient.dialogue: When, Victor. I've got reason to believe that a deformality is being formed here in the W Sector plaza cuz it seems to me that I found a core for one here

The Heart of the Mass Bleeding Patient.speaker: Victor
The Heart of the Mass Bleeding Patient.dialogue: *sigh* I'll be there soon.

The Heart of the Mass Bleeding Patient.speaker: Narration
The Heart of the Mass Bleeding Patient.dialogue: she cut the call and turned to The Monster, who seemed to look away after hearing that the person on the end of the line would be making their was to their location.

The Heart of the Mass Bleeding Patient.speaker: Afine
The Heart of the Mass Bleeding Patient.dialogue: You two got some history or something. I could see you staring hard at my phone once he spoke.

The Heart of the Mass Bleeding Patient.speaker: The Monster
The Heart of the Mass Bleeding Patient.dialogue: ...You could say that.

The Heart of the Mass Bleeding Patient.speaker: Narration
The Heart of the Mass Bleeding Patient.dialogue: Afine stretched her hands before summoning four arrows and shot them towards Joel, however, he caught them with ease

The Heart of the Mass Bleeding Patient.speaker: Joel?
The Heart of the Mass Bleeding Patient.dialogue: Do not hit the cocoon, or this vessel.

The Heart of the Mass Bleeding Patient.speaker: Narration
The Heart of the Mass Bleeding Patient.dialogue: Joel turned around, revealing that he had blood shot eyes as well

The Heart of the Mass Bleeding Patient.speaker: Infected Joel
The Heart of the Mass Bleeding Patient.dialogue: I need him to live again.

The Heart of the Mass Bleeding Patient.speaker: Narration
The Heart of the Mass Bleeding Patient.dialogue: Joel was infected, however, unlike the other infected, he seemed to be able to speak without pauses

The Heart of the Mass Bleeding Patient.speaker: Infected Joel
The Heart of the Mass Bleeding Patient.dialogue: I can hear my heart beating through the core. He told me. He told me that if I was able to absorb that supressor, I could begin the process of becoming human again

The Heart of the Mass Bleeding Patient.speaker: Jasmine
The Heart of the Mass Bleeding Patient.dialogue: He? Listen, we can't let you have him. He's our friend.

The Heart of the Mass Bleeding Patient.speaker: Infected Joel
The Heart of the Mass Bleeding Patient.dialogue: ...I cannot let you do that...

The Heart of the Mass Bleeding Patient.speaker: Narration
The Heart of the Mass Bleeding Patient.dialogue: From the ground, two bloodlings rose as the infected Joel walked over to us, letting go of the arrows he had caught from Afine

The Heart of the Mass Bleeding Patient.speaker: Infected Joel
The Heart of the Mass Bleeding Patient.dialogue: If you choose to stand in my way... then... I'm sorry. I don't want to do this, but I want to be human again. What am I suppose to do? He is the only vessel strong enough to allow me the be transfered to.

The Heart of the Mass Bleeding Patient.speaker: Narration
The Heart of the Mass Bleeding Patient.dialogue: The infected Joel began to staggeredly run at us as the core began to pulse faster. We had no choice but to knock out Joel in battle and think of what to do after

Protect the happy memories.speaker: Narration
Protect the happy memories.dialogue: Our efforts didn't seem to provide any tangible progress. The core was much to durable to be damaged, and when ever Joel took meaningful damage, the core just healed them.

Protect the happy memories.speaker: Narration
Protect the happy memories.dialogue: Once again, we are trapped in a loop of no progress at all as the Core seems to grow bigger. Veins start to sprout from it and surround the area, feeding of the blood on the walls

Protect the happy memories.speaker: Narration
Protect the happy memories.dialogue: Afien turned to me as I tired my best to lead the elite in a way to deal with this issue

Protect the happy memories.speaker: Afine
Protect the happy memories.dialogue: You're the leader of the group right. If we don't take care of that core back there now, it could become a deformality any second

Protect the happy memories.speaker: Victor
Protect the happy memories.dialogue: That's were I come in.

Protect the happy memories.speaker: Narration
Protect the happy memories.dialogue: Appearing from behind us and rushing pass us, a man with glasses and a fancy suit with dark green highlights move towards the core and place his hand on it.

Protect the happy memories.speaker: Narration
Protect the happy memories.dialogue: Suddenly, a piller of ice appeared and seal the core before the man dusted of his hands.

Protect the happy memories.speaker: Victor
Protect the happy memories.dialogue: Well, now that that's dealt wit...

Protect the happy memories.speaker: Narration
Protect the happy memories.dialogue: Without waiting on me for how to approach the situation next, the monster rushed forward and attempted to punch the mans head clean up, but they caught the monsters fist with one of their hands and slowly began to freeze them

Protect the happy memories.speaker: Victor
Protect the happy memories.dialogue: I used to fear you. A beast created by me that believed it had the rigfht to be treated as anything but a beast. I was weak and pathetic back then. But now, I uderstand...

Protect the happy memories.speaker: Narration
Protect the happy memories.dialogue: The man fully freezed the monster and crushed the frozen version of them to bits

Protect the happy memories.speaker: Victor
Protect the happy memories.dialogue: With my scientific knowledge, you no longer pose a threat to me. fall apart and become a past mistake of mine already

Protect the happy memories.speaker: Narration
Protect the happy memories.dialogue: They then looked over to us and bowed

Protect the happy memories.speaker: Victor
Protect the happy memories.dialogue: As for the rest of you who do not know of me, I am Victor Frankenstien. That monster that's on the ground was my fault, but it should be gone now.

Protect the happy memories.speaker: Snowball
Protect the happy memories.dialogue: What the hell is your problem!

Protect the happy memories.speaker: Victor
Protect the happy memories.dialogue: Pardon.

Protect the happy memories.speaker: Narration
Protect the happy memories.dialogue: Snowball speaked up after Victor's introduction in an angered tone

Protect the happy memories.speaker: Snowball
Protect the happy memories.dialogue: He is one of our own. I know not what he may have done to you, but considering the time I have spent with him, I believe he had good reason to do anything, so of course I will defend him

Protect the happy memories.speaker: Victor
Protect the happy memories.dialogue: He is a failed test experiment, hence, he is an error that will not be repeated. You growning attached to this error is, frankly, ammusing to...

Protect the happy memories.speaker: Narration
Protect the happy memories.dialogue: The sound of a camera flash went of, sending a bright light throughout the room. When the light cleard, a good half of the core, which was no longer frozen, was gone. The the core and all the blood in the room disappeared, and all that remained was the corpse of the supressor, Joel, who was knocked out on the ground, and the legs and half of the torso of the patient that was once the core. Notably, no blood poured from the wound

Protect the happy memories.speaker: Victor
Protect the happy memories.dialogue: It... It's gone? How did it. Did any of...

Protect the happy memories.speaker: Narration
Protect the happy memories.dialogue: The man named Victor looked around for what could have destroyed the core, only to find something behind us that made him stop. We looked behind him to he what he was looking at...

Protect the happy memories.speaker: Narration
Protect the happy memories.dialogue: They thing had a fully metallic body, was lankier than usual, and had four arms. Noticably, It's face was replaced by a camera lens.

Protect the happy memories.speaker: Narration
Protect the happy memories.dialogue: The Alteration then seemed to rush over to the area in which Joel was knocked out at and held him upright so that his face was up to it's lens that would act as it's eye.

Protect the happy memories.speaker: Narration
Protect the happy memories.dialogue: Afine and Victor seemed to back away after seeing this alteration.

Protect the happy memories.speaker: Afine
Protect the happy memories.dialogue: Well, I believe our job here is done. You guys can handle this one, right?

Protect the happy memories.speaker: Narration
Protect the happy memories.dialogue: Before I could answer, both Victor and Afine left now that the core had been destroyed and the crisis had been handled
Joel...

Protect the happy memories.speaker: Narration
Protect the happy memories.dialogue: I turn to here the figure utter Joel name in a familiar yet distored sounding voice.
...Wake up... Joel...

Protect the happy memories.speaker: Jasmine
Protect the happy memories.dialogue: E... Emilia?

Protect the happy memories.speaker: Narration
Protect the happy memories.dialogue: The figure slowly turn it's head towards me upon hearing that name, before slowly standing up between our group and Joel

Protect the happy memories.speaker: Narration
Protect the happy memories.dialogue: I use the world key to heal the elite and revive The Monster as the Altered Emilia stands weary of us trying to keep us from getting to Joel

Protect the happy memories.speaker: Altered Emilia
Protect the happy memories.dialogue: You did this to him. Didn't you?

Protect the happy memories.speaker: Narration
Protect the happy memories.dialogue: The figure doesn't seem to give us a chance to answer, starting to use physical force to drive us away.

Protect the happy memories.speaker: Jasmine
Protect the happy memories.dialogue: Guys. We gotta stop her before she causes to much trouble.

Protect the happy memories.speaker: Kyla
Protect the happy memories.dialogue: Understandable. We should try to calm her. The symptoms are not permanent until the core stage, so if we can give her a reason to believe that we are trying to help Joel, they may revert back to normal.

Protect the happy memories.speaker: Narration
Protect the happy memories.dialogue: The elite all prepare to fight again as we attempt to subdue the raging Emilia.

Onward2.1.speaker: Narration
Onward2.1.dialogue: After a long while of fighting her in a way that wouldn't harm her to much.

Onward2.1.speaker: Jasmine
Onward2.1.dialogue: Emilia. Calm down. We're trying to help you.

Onward2.1.speaker: Narration
Onward2.1.dialogue: The Altered Emilia didn't seem to listen, and was trashing around trying to escape the Monsters grip

Onward2.1.speaker: The Monster
Onward2.1.dialogue: Are you sure this alteration is Emilia. They don't act similar at all.

Onward2.1.speaker: Joel
Onward2.1.dialogue: Yeah... That's her...

Onward2.1.speaker: Narration
Onward2.1.dialogue: I turn to the left to see Joel, standing up again, awoken from our recent fight.

Onward2.1.speaker: Emilia
Onward2.1.dialogue: ...Joel

Onward2.1.speaker: Narration
Onward2.1.dialogue: Suddenly, upon hearing Joel's voice, seemed to immediately revert back to her original form and collapse after the Monster loosened his grip on her.

Onward2.1.speaker: Jasmine
Onward2.1.dialogue: H-How did you know it was her.

Onward2.1.speaker: Joel
Onward2.1.dialogue: The patient. It's the same type of wound that the animals had, exact same actually.

Onward2.1.speaker: Narration
Onward2.1.dialogue: Joel walked over toher and carried her on his shoulder before pausing for a second

Onward2.1.speaker: Joel
Onward2.1.dialogue: Y'know. I could hear the voice of... whoever that patient was. They were scared, afraid, obviously, but... they also thought about one other thing.

Onward2.1.speaker: Narration
Onward2.1.dialogue: Joel looked to Kyla, who seemed to have the closest contects with Havenus

Onward2.1.speaker: Joel
Onward2.1.dialogue: That syringe that one of the hospital had, the one that made them what they became, there's more of them. They're being mass produced somewhere in G Sector.

Onward2.1.speaker: Narration
Onward2.1.dialogue: Kyla seemed to have a negative reaction to hearing the words G Sector, but regained her composure and responded to Joel

Onward2.1.speaker: Kyla
Onward2.1.dialogue: I'll make sure the Oddity Team knows about this...

Onward2.1.speaker: Jasmine
Onward2.1.dialogue: Woah, woah, woah. We're moving a little bit to fast. I'll start with the first question I have: Joel, about Emilia becoming altered, has it ever happened before?

Onward2.1.speaker: Narration
Onward2.1.dialogue: Joel stood silent for a second before continuing

Onward2.1.speaker: Joel
Onward2.1.dialogue: The lady with the fans, she didn't always have them. She, for some reason, wants Emilia. That syringe I was talking about, Emilia was injected with it by her. I was able to bring her back to her sense, but she's always seemed to be emotionally unstable ever since.

Onward2.1.speaker: Narration
Onward2.1.dialogue: So that's why the lady blocked our path when we entered W Sector.

Onward2.1.speaker: Jasmine
Onward2.1.dialogue: And you Kyla, what is the Oddity Team

Onward2.1.speaker: Kyla
Onward2.1.dialogue: Well, we are the Elite team, tasked currently with the containment and disposal of the spectral cores. The Oddity team is tasked with maintaining anything relating to Alterations and Deformalities.

Onward2.1.speaker: Narration
Onward2.1.dialogue: Kyla paused for a bit before continuing.

Onward2.1.speaker: Kyla
Onward2.1.dialogue: ...I used to be a part of their group. They were nice people, especially the Blood Paddle.

Onward2.1.speaker: George
Onward2.1.dialogue: The Blood Paddle. You mean that Blood Paddle. They're one of the most well known supressor that aren't a high ranked one within the crater.

Onward2.1.speaker: Kyla
Onward2.1.dialogue: Yeah. The last mission they had to deal with before I transfered to this group was the finding and destroying of the shados syringes, the item that can influence Alteration if people instantly.

Onward2.1.speaker: Narration
Onward2.1.dialogue: So Kyla used to work with a group working to get rid of the syringes. That's interesting, I guess

Onward2.1.speaker: Jasmine
Onward2.1.dialogue: Alright now that were all together, let's get out of here.

Onward2.1.speaker: Narration
Onward2.1.dialogue: On our way to the exit, there wasn't any waves of shoppers other than the former infected shoppers that were knocked unconcious on the ground around us.

Onward2.1.speaker: Narration
Onward2.1.dialogue: Outside the plaza was a spacious Jet marked with the Havenus logo. A man stepped off of it with a smile.

Onward2.1.speaker: Pilot
Onward2.1.dialogue: Well, well. The Elite squad in the flesh. Your groups been moving quite fast around this crater, huh Kyla.

Onward2.1.speaker: Narration
Onward2.1.dialogue: Kyla seemed sigh in an annoyed manner upon hearing the voice of the person within the jet

Onward2.1.speaker: Kyla
Onward2.1.dialogue: Max....

Onward2.1.speaker: Max
Onward2.1.dialogue: Aww, what's wrong. Don't like the fact that I gotta work with you again. Well someones gotta get you round this place, and the higher-ups thought I was the best from the Transport Team to help you out

Onward2.1.speaker: Narration
Onward2.1.dialogue: Kyla just walked past him and into the jet wtihout paying him any thought

Onward2.1.speaker: Max
Onward2.1.dialogue: Damn, why you gotta be so rude? Oh, and who are you?

Onward2.1.speaker: Narration
Onward2.1.dialogue: They seemed to rush over to me, getting insanely close to me upon seeing my bewildered staring at Kyla

Onward2.1.speaker: Jasmine
Onward2.1.dialogue: Woah!

Onward2.1.speaker: Max
Onward2.1.dialogue: You must be the captain of this band of peps. You've got the looks of a captain as well. A beautiful one...

Onward2.1.speaker: Romeo
Onward2.1.dialogue: I aknowledge your appretiate of our leader, but I believe she could use some space.

Onward2.1.speaker: Narration
Onward2.1.dialogue: Max seemed to turn his head towards Romeo with a frown before sighing and backing off.

Onward2.1.speaker: Max
Onward2.1.dialogue: Whatever, loverboy. You're probably after her, aren't you?

Onward2.1.speaker: Romeo
Onward2.1.dialogue: Why would I.

Onward2.1.speaker: Narration
Onward2.1.dialogue: Romeo immediately responded in a calm, composed voice as if to deny any truth in the statement. Max scoffed afterwards and just entered the jet

Onward2.1.speaker: Joel
Onward2.1.dialogue: I'm guessing that's why Kyla acted so hard around him. He's probably a womanizer.

Onward2.1.speaker: Jasmine
Onward2.1.dialogue: This is really the best guy we've got? You know what, whatever. Let's just go already.

Onward2.1.speaker: Narration
Onward2.1.dialogue: The rest of the elite move into the jet and take our seats.

Onward2.1.speaker: Context
Onward2.1.dialogue: Somewhere in G Sector

Onward2.1.speaker: Context Narration
Onward2.1.dialogue: Within a facility, several more people in the same hospital staff clothing were working on creating a black substance before putting them in a syringe. Behind them was a group of cages filled with several Deformalities and Alterations being watched over by heavily armoured individuals with high grade weapons.

Onward2.1.speaker: Context Narration
Onward2.1.dialogue: Watching over them were two men, one of them in a clean looking doctors outfit and a checkboard and pen in hand, and one with a walking stick in hand and a cigar in the other. The man in the doctors outfit began to speak to the other

Onward2.1.speaker: The Doctor
Onward2.1.dialogue: Well, as you can see Mr Birling, production of the substance is going very well, however, we haven't seemed to figure out a way to enforce Limit Breaking as of now, but not to worry. Our staff are strong at work in W, Q, N Sector and here to make such a discovery

Onward2.1.speaker: Mr Birling
Onward2.1.dialogue: Excellent work, doctor. Please know that you have Birling and Co.'s full support in this endevour. Although, I am yet to get an account back from that Lila you sent to test the...

Onward2.1.speaker: Context Narration
Onward2.1.dialogue: Suddenly, Lila barged into the room from another door in the facility. She was walking with a limp and was decently injured.

Onward2.1.speaker: Lila
Onward2.1.dialogue: Doctor, I've returned...

Onward2.1.speaker: The Doctor
Onward2.1.dialogue: Lila, my girl, what happened to you?

Onward2.1.speaker: Lila
Onward2.1.dialogue: The girl... they recovered from it.

Onward2.1.speaker: The Doctor
Onward2.1.dialogue: Recovered from it. That special one that was meant for protection. That syringe was special, meant to create the strongest alteration to exist. It shouldn't be possible to recover from that!

Onward2.1.speaker: Mr Birling
Onward2.1.dialogue: We'll need to find them then, won't we?

Onward2.1.speaker: Lila
Onward2.1.dialogue: Well actually... I did find them, but the group was able to beat me before I could grab and escape with her. Notably, among them was a member of the 12 watcher's called Inspector Goole

Onward2.1.speaker: Mr Birling
Onward2.1.dialogue: Him...

Onward2.1.speaker: The Doctor
Onward2.1.dialogue: You know them?

Onward2.1.speaker: Mr Birling
Onward2.1.dialogue: We have some history... He's the main reason Birling and Co is a syndicate and not an official Divinus recognised group. I sent a couple of my men to beat him down and leave him to die. I guess some group picked him up and left with him.

Onward2.1.speaker: Context Narration
Onward2.1.dialogue: Suddenly, Mr Birling's phone began to buzz within his pocket as someone was trying to access his line. He picked up the phone.

Onward2.1.speaker: W Sector Birling Captain
Onward2.1.dialogue: Mr Birling sir. Thank you for answering.

Onward2.1.speaker: Mr Birling
Onward2.1.dialogue: Yes yes. Thank you for the greating. What are you calling me for anyways...

Onward2.1.speaker: W Sector Birling Captain
Onward2.1.dialogue: The Medical branch within W Sector's plaza has been discovered by Havenus and Divinus groups and has been cleared out. Fortunately, some of our spies within the wave of shoppers spotted their group. They're heading to E Sector next, and they have that Watcher with them.

Onward2.1.speaker: Context Narration
Onward2.1.dialogue: The room was dead silent for a bit, then Mr Birling responded

Onward2.1.speaker: Mr Birling
Onward2.1.dialogue: I'll inform the group in E Sector about this. Thank's for informing me.

Onward2.1.speaker: Context Narration
Onward2.1.dialogue: The phone was cut by Mr Birling before he put his phone away.

Onward2.1.speaker: Mr Birling
Onward2.1.dialogue: Keep up the good work here. I'll focus on the finding of the girl...
